english_translations.sahih_international: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
english_translations.pickthall: Slay not your children, fearing a fall to poverty, We shall provide for them and for you. Lo! the slaying of them is great sin.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Kill not your children for fear of want: We shall provide sustenance for them as well as for you. Verily the killing of them is a great sin.
english_translations.shakir: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty; We give them sustenance and yourselves (too); surely to kill them is a great wrong.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We will give sustenance to all of you. To kill them is certainly a great sin.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And kill not your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Surely, the killing of them is a great sin.
english_translations.arberry: And slay not your children for fear of poverty; We will provide for you and them; surely the slaying of them is a grievous sin.

ayahs.transliteration: walā taqrabū l-zinā innahu kāna fāḥishatan wasāa sabīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আর যিনা-ব্যভিচারের কাছেও যেও না, তা হচ্ছে অশ্লীল কাজ আর অতি জঘন্য পথ।
ayahs.translation_en: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর ব্যভিচারের কাছেও যেও না; নিশ্চয়ই তা এক অশ্লীল কাজ ও নিকৃষ্ট পথ।

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not approach unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
english_translations.pickthall: And come not near unto adultery. Lo! it is an abomination and an evil way.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Nor come nigh to adultery: for it is a shameful (deed) and an evil, opening the road (to other evils).
english_translations.shakir: And go not nigh to fornication; surely it is an indecency and an evil way.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not even approach adultery. It is indecent and an evil act.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And come not near to the unlawful sexual intercourse. Verily, it is a Fahishah [i.e. anything that transgresses its limits (a great sin)], and an evil way (that leads one to Hell unless Allah forgives him).
english_translations.arberry: And approach not fornication; surely it is an indecency, and evil as a way.

ayahs.transliteration: walā taqtulū l-nafsa allatī ḥarrama l-lahu illā bil-ḥaqi waman qutila maẓlūman faqad jaʿalnā liwaliyyihi sul'ṭānan falā yus'rif fī l-qatli innahu kāna manṣūran
ayahs.translation_bn: যথাযথ কারণ ছাড়া আল্লাহ যাকে হত্যা করা নিষিদ্ধ করেছেন তাকে হত্যা করো না। কাউকে অন্যায়ভাবে হত্যা করা হলে আমি তার উত্তরাধিকারীকে অধিকার দিয়েছি (কিসাস দাবী করার বা ক্ষমা করে দেয়ার) কাজেই সে যেন হত্যার ব্যাপারে সীমালঙ্ঘন না করে, কারণ তাকে তো সাহায্য করা হয়েছে (আইন-বিধান দিয়ে)।
ayahs.translation_en: And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যথার্থ কারণ ছাড়া এমন কোনো প্রাণকে হত্যা করো না যা আল্লাহ নিষিদ্ধ করেছেন; আর কাউকে অন্যায়ভাবে হত্যা করা হলে আমি তার উত্তরাধিকারীকে ক্ষমতা দিয়েছি, কাজেই সে যেন হত্যার ব্যাপারে বাড়াবাড়ি না করে; নিশ্চয়ই সে সাহায্যপ্রাপ্ত।
ayahs.meta_bn: লাইফ-নোড স্যাংটিটি ও লিগ্যাল জাস্টিস থ্রুটপুট

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].
english_translations.pickthall: And slay not the life which Allah hath forbidden save with right. Whoso is slain wrongfully, We have given power unto his heir, but let him not commit excess in slaying. Lo! he will be helped.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Nor take life - which Allah has made sacred - except for just cause. And if anyone is slain wrongfully, we have given his heir authority (to demand qisas or to forgive): but let him not exceed bounds in the matter of taking life; for he is helped (by the Law).
english_translations.shakir: And do not kill any one whom Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause, and whoever is slain unjustly, We have indeed given to his heir authority, so let him not exceed the just limits in slaying; surely he is aided.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not kill a respectable soul without a just cause. If anyone is wrongfully killed, we have given the heirs of that person the right (to demand satisfaction or to forgive). He must not exceed the law in having vengeance; his victim shall also be assisted (by law).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And do not kill anyone which Allah has forbidden, except for a just cause. And whoever is killed (intentionally with hostility and oppression and not by mistake), We have given his heir the authority [(to demand Qisas, Law of Equality in punishment or to forgive, or to take Diya (blood money)]. But let him not exceed limits in the matter of taking life (i.e. he should not kill except the killer only). Verily, he is helped (by the Islamic law).
english_translations.arberry: And slay not the soul God has forbidden, except by right. Whosoever is slain unjustly, We have appointed to his next-of-kin authority; but let him not exceed in slaying; he shall be helped.

ayahs.transliteration: walā taqrabū māla l-yatīmi illā bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu ḥattā yablugha ashuddahu wa-awfū bil-ʿahdi inna l-ʿahda kāna masūlan
ayahs.translation_bn: ইয়াতীম বয়োপ্রাপ্ত না হওয়া পর্যন্ত তার সম্পদের কাছেও যেয়ো না সৎ উদ্দেশ্য ব্যতীত। আর ওয়া‘দা পূর্ণ কর, ওয়া‘দা সম্পর্কে অবশ্যই জিজ্ঞাসাবাদ করা হবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর এতিমের সম্পদের কাছে যেও না, যতক্ষণ না সে বয়োপ্রাপ্ত হয়—উত্তম পন্থা ব্যতীত; এবং অঙ্গীকার পূর্ণ করো, নিশ্চয়ই অঙ্গীকার সম্পর্কে জবাবদিহি করতে হবে।
ayahs.meta_bn: অরফান নোড প্রটেকশন ও কন্ট্রাক্ট ইন্টিগ্রিটি অডিট

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not approach the property of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.
english_translations.pickthall: Come not near the wealth of the orphan save with that which is better till he come to strength; and keep the covenant. Lo! of the covenant it will be asked.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Come not nigh to the orphan's property except to improve it, until he attains the age of full strength; and fulfil (every) engagement, for (every) engagement will be enquired into (on the Day of Reckoning).
english_translations.shakir: And draw not near to the property of the orphan except in a goodly way till he attains his maturity and fulfill the promise; surely (every) promise shall be questioned about.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not get close to the property of the orphans (unless it is for a good reason) until they are mature and strong. Keep your promise; you will be questioned about it.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And come not near to the orphan's property except to improve it, until he attains the age of full strength. And fulfil (every) covenant. Verily! the covenant, will be questioned about.
english_translations.arberry: And do not approach the property of the orphan save in the fairest manner, until he is of age. And fulfil the covenant; surely the covenant shall be questioned of.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-awfū l-kayla idhā kil'tum wazinū bil-qis'ṭāsi l-mus'taqīmi dhālika khayrun wa-aḥsanu tawīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: মাপ দেয়ার সময় মাপ পূর্ণমাত্রায় করবে, আর ওজন করবে ত্রুটিহীন দাঁড়িপাল্লায়। এটাই উত্তম নীতি আর পরিণামেও তা উৎকৃষ্ট।
ayahs.translation_en: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
ayahs.conventional_en: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর পরিমাপ করার সময় পূর্ণ মাপে দেবে এবং সঠিক দাঁড়িপাল্লায় ওজন করবে; এটাই উত্তম এবং পরিণামে উৎকৃষ্ট।
ayahs.meta_bn: মেজারমেন্ট প্রিসিশন ও অপটিমাইজড ট্রানজ্যাকশন স্কেল
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: الۡکَيۡلَ — ডেটা-আউটপুট পরিমাপ; الۡقِسۡطَاسِ الۡمُسۡتَقِيۡمِ — ডেটা-অপটিমাইজড নির্ভুল দাঁড়িপাল্লা; تَاۡوِيۡلًا — চূড়ান্ত ফলাফল / পরিণতি।

english_translations.sahih_international: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
english_translations.pickthall: Fill the measure when ye measure, and weigh with a right balance; that is meet, and better in the end.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Give full measure when ye measure, and weigh with a balance that is straight: that is the most fitting and the most advantageous in the final determination.
english_translations.shakir: And give full measure when you measure out, and weigh with a true balance; this is fair and better in the end.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: While weighing, use proper measurements in the exchange of your property. This is fair and will be better in the end.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with a balance that is straight. That is good (advantageous) and better in the end.
english_translations.arberry: And fill up the measure when you measure, and weigh with the straight balance; that is better and fairer in the issue.

ayahs.transliteration: walā taqfu mā laysa laka bihi ʿil'mun inna l-samʿa wal-baṣara wal-fuāda kullu ulāika kāna ʿanhu masūlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আর সে বিষয়ের পেছনে ছুটো না, যে বিষয়ে তোমার কোন জ্ঞান নেই। কান, চোখ আর অন্তর- এগুলোর সকল বিষয়ে অবশ্যই জিজ্ঞাসাবাদ করা হবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যে বিষয়ে তোমার কোনো জ্ঞান নেই, তার পেছনে ছুmetaটো না; নিশ্চয়ই কান, চোখ ও হৃদয়—এদের প্রতিটির বিষয়েই জবাবদিহি করতে হবে।
ayahs.meta_bn: সেন্সরি ভ্যালিডেশন ও কগনিটিভ প্রসেসিং অডিট
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: تَقۡفُ — ডেটা-ফলো করা / অন্ধভাবে অনুসরণ; السَّمۡعَ وَالۡبَصَرَ وَالۡفُؤَادَ — অডিও-ভিজুয়াল সেন্সর ও কগনিটিভ প্রসেসিং কোর (কান, চোখ ও হৃদয়)।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: تَقۡفُ — ডেটা-ফলো করা / অন্ধভাবে অনুসরণ; السَّمۡعَ وَالۡبَصَرَ وَالۡفُؤَادَ — অডিও-ভিজুয়াল সেন্সর ও কগনিটিভ প্রসেসিং কোর (কান, চোখ ও হৃদয়)।
metadata.theme_bn: অনুমানভিত্তিক জ্ঞানের অনুসরণ নিষিদ্ধকরণ: কান, চোখ ও অন্তরের সার্বিক জবাবদিহিতা

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
english_translations.pickthall: (O man), follow not that whereof thou hast no knowledge. Lo! the hearing and the sight and the heart - of each of these it will be asked.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And pursue not that of which thou hast no knowledge; for every act of hearing, or of seeing or of (feeling in) the heart will be enquired into (on the Day of Reckoning).
english_translations.shakir: And follow not that of which you have not the knowledge; surely the hearing and the sight and the heart, all of these, shall be questioned about that.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not follow what you do not know; the ears, eyes, and hearts will all be held responsible for their deeds.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And follow not (O man i.e., say not, or do not or witness not, etc.) that of which you have no knowledge (e.g. one's saying: "I have seen," while in fact he has not seen, or "I have heard," while he has not heard). Verily! The hearing, and the sight, and the heart, of each of those you will be questioned (by Allah).
english_translations.arberry: And pursue not that thou hast no knowledge of; the hearing, the sight, the heart -- all of those shall be questioned of.

ayahs.transliteration: walā tamshi fī l-arḍi maraḥan innaka lan takhriqa l-arḍa walan tablugha l-jibāla ṭūlan
ayahs.translation_bn: যমীনে গর্বভরে চলাফেরা করো না, তুমি কক্ষনো যমীনকে বিদীর্ণ করতে পারবে না, আর উচ্চতায় পর্বতের ন্যায় হতেও পারবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
ayahs.conventional_en: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যমীনে দম্ভভরে পদচারণা করো না; তুমি কখনই যমীনকে বিদীর্ণ করতে পারবে না এবং উচ্চতায় পর্বতের সমানও পৌঁছাতে পারবে না।
ayahs.meta_bn: বায়ো-স্ফিয়ার ইকুইলিব্রিয়াম ও অ্যান্টি-এরোগ্যান্স জিওমেট্রি

english_translations.sahih_international: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
english_translations.pickthall: And walk not in the earth exultant. Lo! thou canst not rend the earth, nor canst thou stretch to the height of the hills.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Nor walk on the earth with insolence: for thou canst not rend the earth asunder, nor reach the mountains in height.
english_translations.shakir: And do not go about in the land exultingly, for you cannot cut through the earth nor reach the mountains in height.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do not walk proudly on the earth; your feet cannot tear apart the earth nor are you as tall as the mountains.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And walk not on the earth with conceit and arrogance. Verily, you can neither rend nor penetrate the earth, nor can you attain a stature like the mountains in height.
english_translations.arberry: And walk not in the earth exultantly; certainly thou wilt never tear the earth open, nor attain the mountains in height.

ayahs.transliteration: kullu dhālika kāna sayyi-uhu ʿinda rabbika makrūhan
ayahs.translation_bn: এগুলোর মধ্যে যে সমস্ত বিষয় মন্দ, তোমার প্রতিপালকের নিকট তা ঘৃণিত।
ayahs.translation_en: All that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
ayahs.conventional_en: All that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
ayahs.conventional_bn: এগুলোর মধ্যকার সব মন্দ বিষয়ই তোমার প্রতিপালকের কাছে অপছন্দনীয়।
ayahs.meta_bn: সিস্টেমিক ম্যাল-ফাংশন ও রুট ডিরেক্টরি রিজেকশন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: سَيِّئُهٗ — ক্ষতিকর মন্দ দিক; مَكۡرُوۡهًا — ডেটা-রিজেক্টেড / অপছন্দনীয় ও ঘৃণিত।

english_translations.sahih_international: All that - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
english_translations.pickthall: The evil of all that is hateful in the sight of thy Lord.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Of all such things the evil is hateful in the sight of thy Lord.
english_translations.shakir: All this-- the evil of it-- is hateful in the sight of your Lord.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: All such things are sins and detestable in the sight of your Lord.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: All the bad aspects of these (the above mentioned things) are hateful to your Lord.
english_translations.arberry: All of that -- the wickedness of it is hateful in the sight of thy Lord has revealed to thee:

ayahs.transliteration: dhālika mimmā awḥā ilayka rabbuka mina l-ḥik'mati walā tajʿal maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatul'qā fī jahannama malūman madḥūran
ayahs.translation_bn: এসব সেই হিকমাতের অন্তর্ভুক্ত যা তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমার প্রতি ওয়াহী করেছেন। আল্লাহর সঙ্গে অপর কোন ইলাহ স্থির করো না, করলে তুমি নিন্দিত ও যাবতীয় কল্যাণ বঞ্চিত হয়ে জাহান্নামে নিক্ষিপ্ত হবে।
ayahs.translation_en: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
ayahs.conventional_en: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
ayahs.conventional_bn: এগুলো সেই হিকমতের অন্তর্ভুক্ত, যা তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমার প্রতি ওহী করেছেন; আর আল্লাহর সাথে অন্য কোনো ইলাহ স্থির করো না, অন্যথায় তুমি নিন্দিত ও বিতাড়িত অবস্থায় জাহান্নামে নিক্ষিপ্ত হবে।
ayahs.meta_bn: কোর ডেটা-উইজডম ও থার্মোডাইনামিক ক্র্যাশ-জোন প্রিভেনশন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: مِنَ الۡحِكۡمَةِ — ডেটা-উইজডম / প্রজ্ঞা; جَهَنَّمَ — থার্মোডাইনামিক ক্র্যাশ-জোন; مَّدۡحُوۡرًا — ডেটা-ব্লকড / বিতাড়িত।

english_translations.sahih_international: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
english_translations.pickthall: This is (part) of that wisdom wherewith thy Lord hath inspired thee (O Muhammad). And set not up with Allah any other god, lest thou be cast into hell, reproved, abandoned.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: These are among the (precepts of) wisdom, which thy Lord has revealed to thee. Take not, with Allah, another object of worship, lest thou shouldst be thrown into Hell, blameworthy and rejected.
english_translations.shakir: This is of what your Lord has revealed to you of wisdom, and do not associate any other god with Allah lest you should be thrown into hell, blamed, cast away.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), these are words of wisdom which your Lord has revealed to you. Do not consider anything equal to God lest you be thrown into hell, despised, and driven away from God's mercy.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: This is (part) of Al-Hikmah (wisdom, good manners and high character, etc.) which your Lord has inspired to you (O Muhammad SAW). And set not up with Allah any other ilah (god) lest you should be thrown into Hell, blameworthy and rejected, (from Allah's Mercy).
english_translations.arberry: That is of the wisdom thy Lord set not up with God another god, or thou wilt be cast into Gehenna, reproached and rejected.

ayahs.transliteration: afa-aṣfākum rabbukum bil-banīna wa-ittakhadha mina l-malāikati ināthan innakum lataqūlūna qawlan ʿaẓīman
ayahs.translation_bn: তাহলে কি (হে কাফিরগণ!) তোমাদের জন্য তোমাদের প্রতিপালক সন্তান নির্বাচিত করেছেন, আর নিজের জন্য ফেরেশতাদের মধ্য হতে কন্যা গ্রহণ করেছেন? বাস্তবিকই তোমরা বড় ভয়ানক কথা বলছো।
ayahs.translation_en: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
ayahs.conventional_en: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমাদের প্রতিপালক কি তোমাদের জন্য পুত্রদের বিশিষ্ট করেছেন এবং নিজের জন্য ফেরেশতাদের মধ্য থেকে কন্যা গ্রহণ করেছেন? নিশ্চয়ই তোমরা এক মারাত্মক কথা বলছ!
ayahs.meta_bn: বায়োলজিক্যাল অ্যাসিমেট্রি ও ফলস জেন্ডার অ্যাট্রিবিউশন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: اَفَاَصۡفٰٮكُمۡ — ডেটা-সিলেক্ট / মনোনীত করা; الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ — কসমিক ফোর্সেস নোড; قَوۡلًا عَظِيۡمًا — অত্যন্ত ডেটা-ভারী ও গুরুতর দাবি।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: اَفَاَصۡفٰٮكُمۡ — ডেটা-সিলেক্ট / মনোনীত করা; الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ — কসমিক ফোর্সেস নোড; قَوۡلًا عَظِيۡمًا — অত্যন্ত ডেটা-ভারী ও গুরুতর দাবি।
metadata.theme_bn: আল্লাহর প্রতি কন্যাসন্তান আরোপের অপবাদ খণ্ডন: ফেরেশতাদের নিয়ে চরম বিভ্রান্তিকর দাবির প্রতিবাদ

english_translations.sahih_international: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
english_translations.pickthall: Hath your Lord then distinguished you (O men of Makka) by giving you sons, and hath chosen for Himself females from among the angels? Lo! verily ye speak an awful word!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Has then your Lord (O Pagans!) preferred for you sons, and taken for Himself daughters among the angels? Truly ye utter a most dreadful saying!
english_translations.shakir: What! has then your Lord preferred to give you sons, and (for Himself) taken daughters from among the angels? Most surely you utter a grievous saying.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Pagans) has your Lord given you preference over Himself by granting you sons and taking the angels as His own daughters? What you say is a monstrous utterance.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Has then your Lord (O pagans of Makkah) preferred for you sons, and taken for Himself from among the angels daughters. Verily! You utter an awful saying, indeed.
english_translations.arberry: What, has your Lord favoured you with sons and taken to Himself from the angels females? Surely it is a monstrous thing you are saying!

ayahs.transliteration: walaqad ṣarrafnā fī hādhā l-qur'āni liyadhakkarū wamā yazīduhum illā nufūran
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি এ কুরআনে নানাভাবে (বিষয়াবলী) ব্যাখ্যা করেছি যাতে তারা উপদেশ গ্রহণ করে, কিন্তু তা তাদের (সত্য হতে) পলায়নের মনোবৃত্তিই বৃদ্ধি করেছে।
ayahs.translation_en: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur'an that mankind may be reminded, but it does not increase the disbelievers except in aversion.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur'an that mankind may be reminded, but it does not increase the disbelievers except in aversion.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি এই কুরআনে বিভিন্নভাবে বর্ণনা করেছি—যাতে তারা উপদেশ গ্রহণ করে; কিন্তু তা তাদের বিমুখতাই বৃদ্ধি করে।
ayahs.meta_bn: মাল্টিপল ডেটা-প্যাটার্ন ও সিস্টেমিক রিজেকশন স্টেট

english_translations.sahih_international: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur'an that mankind may be reminded, but it does not increase the disbelievers except in aversion.
english_translations.pickthall: We verily have displayed (Our warnings) in this Qur'an that they may take heed, but it increaseth them in naught save aversion.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: We have explained (things) in various (ways) in this Qur'an, in order that they may receive admonition, but it only increases their flight (from the Truth)!
english_translations.shakir: And certainly We have repeated (warnings) in this Quran that they may be mindful, but it does not add save to their aversion.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have given you various facts (about the Truth in this Quran) so that they (unbelievers) would take heed, but this has only increased their aversion (to the truth).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And surely, We have explained [Our Promises, Warnings and (set forth many) examples] in this Quran that they (the disbelievers) may take heed, but it increases them in naught save aversion.
english_translations.arberry: We have turned about in this Koran, that they may remember; and it increases them only in aversion.

ayahs.transliteration: qul law kāna maʿahu ālihatun kamā yaqūlūna idhan la-ib'taghaw ilā dhī l-ʿarshi sabīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: বল- তাঁর সঙ্গে যদি আরো ইলাহ থাকত যেমন তারা বলে, তাহলে তারা অবশ্যই আরশের মালিকের নিকট পৌঁছার জন্য পথের সন্ধান করত।
ayahs.translation_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way."
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, [O Muhammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way."
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো, ‘যদি তাঁর সাথে আরও ইলাহ থাকত—যেমন তারা বলে—তবে তারা আরশের অধিপতির দিকে পথ খুঁজত’!
ayahs.meta_bn: কসমিক অ্যাডমিন লেয়ার ও পলিথেইস্টিক কনফ্লিক্ট
ayahs.meta_en: Cosmic Admin Layer & Polytheistic Collision Contradiction

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way."
english_translations.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): If there were other gods along with Him, as they say, then had they sought a way against the Lord of the Throne.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: If there had been (other) gods with Him, as they say,- behold, they would certainly have sought out a way to the Lord of the Throne!
english_translations.shakir: Say: If there were with Him gods as they say, then certainly they would have been able to seek a way to the Lord of power.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), ask them, "Had there been many other gods besides Him, as they say, they should have found a way to the Lord of the Throne
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW to these polytheists, pagans, etc.): "If there had been other aliha (gods) along with Him as they assert, then they would certainly have sought out a way to the Lord of the Throne (seeking His Pleasures and to be near to Him).
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'If there had been other gods with Him, as they say, in that case assuredly they would have sought a way unto the Lord of the Throne.' Glory be to Him!

ayahs.transliteration: sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yaqūlūna ʿuluwwan kabīran
ayahs.translation_bn: তিনি পবিত্র ও অতি উচ্চ, তারা যা বলে তাত্থেকে অনেক অনেক ঊর্ধ্বে।
ayahs.translation_en: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
ayahs.conventional_en: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তিনি পবিত্র, সমুন্নত এবং তারা যা বলে তা থেকে তিনি বহু ঊর্ধ্বে—মহিমান্বিত।
ayahs.meta_bn: সিস্টেম-পিউরিটি মোড ও ইনকম্প্যারেবল ট্রান্সেন্ডেন্স
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: سُبۡحٰنَهٗ — সিস্টেম-পিউরিটি মোড; عُلُوًّا كَبِيۡرًا — বহু ডেটা-এলিভেটেড / সুউচ্চ মহিমা।

english_translations.sahih_international: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
english_translations.pickthall: Glorified is He, and High Exalted above what they say!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Glory to Him! He is high above all that they say!- Exalted and Great (beyond measure)!
english_translations.shakir: Glory be to Him and exalted be He in high exaltation above what they say.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (to challenge Him). God is too Glorious and Exalted to be considered as they believe Him to be. He is the most High and Great.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Glorified and High be He! From 'Uluwan Kabira (the great falsehood) that they say! (i.e. forged statements that there are other gods along with Allah, but He is Allah, the One, the Self-Sufficient Master, whom all creatures need. He begets not, nor was He begotten, and there is none comparable or coequal unto Him).
english_translations.arberry: High indeed be He exalted above that they say!

ayahs.transliteration: tusabbiḥu lahu l-samāwātu l-sabʿu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna wa-in min shayin illā yusabbiḥu biḥamdihi walākin lā tafqahūna tasbīḥahum innahu kāna ḥalīman ghafūran
ayahs.translation_bn: সাত আসমান, যমীন আর এগুলোর মাঝে যা আছে সব কিছুই তাঁর মহিমা ঘোষণা করে। এমন কোন জিনিসই নেই যা তাঁর প্রশংসাসহ পবিত্রতা ও মহিমা ঘোষণা করে না। কিন্তু তোমরা বুঝতে পার না কীভাবে তারা তাঁর মহিমা ঘোষণা করে। তিনি পরম সহিষ্ণু, বড়ই ক্ষমাপরায়ণ।
ayahs.translation_en: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allah] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.
ayahs.conventional_en: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allah] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.
ayahs.conventional_bn: সপ্ত আসমান, পৃথিবী এবং এদের মধ্যে যা কিছু আছে—সবই তাঁর পবিত্রতা ও মহিমা ঘোষণা করে; এবং এমন কোনো কিছু নেই যা তাঁর প্রশংসার সাথে পবিত্রতা ঘোষণা করে না; কিন্তু তোমরা তাদের পবিত্রতা ঘোষণা অনুধাবন করতে পারো না; নিশ্চয়ই তিনি পরম সহনশীল, পরম ক্ষমাশীল।
ayahs.meta_bn: কসমিক রেজোন্যান্স ও ইউনিভার্সাল সিস্টেম টলারেন্স
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: تُسَبِّحُ — সিস্টেম-পিউরিটি মোড সিগন্যাল ট্রান্সমিট করা; حَلِيۡمًا — সিস্টেম টলারেন্স / পরম সহনশীল।

english_translations.sahih_international: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [Allah] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.
english_translations.pickthall: The seven heavens and the earth and all that is therein praise Him, and there is not a thing but hymneth His praise; but ye understand not their praise. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: The seven heavens and the earth, and all beings therein, declare His glory: there is not a thing but celebrates His praise; And yet ye understand not how they declare His glory! Verily He is Oft-Forbear, Most Forgiving!
english_translations.shakir: The seven heavens declare His glory and the earth (too), and those who are in them; and there is not a single thing but glorifies Him with His praise, but you do not understand their glorification; surely He is Forbearing, Forgiving.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The seven heavens, the earth, and whatever is between them all glorify Him. There is nothing that does not glorify Him and always praise him, but you do not understand their praise and glorification. He is All-forbearing and All-forgiving.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: The seven heavens and the earth and all that is therein, glorify Him and there is not a thing but glorifies His Praise. But you understand not their glorification. Truly, He is Ever Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.
english_translations.arberry: The seven heavens and the earth, and whosoever in them is, extol Him; nothing is, that does not proclaim His praise, but you do not understand their extolling. Surely He is All-clement, All-forgiving.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā qarata l-qur'āna jaʿalnā baynaka wabayna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ḥijāban mastūran
ayahs.translation_bn: তুমি যখন কুরআন পাঠ কর তখন আমি তোমার আর যারা আখেরাতে বিশ্বাস করে না তাদের মাঝে একটা অদৃশ্য পর্দা স্থাপন ক’রে দিয়েছি।
ayahs.translation_en: And when you recite the Qur'an, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.
ayahs.conventional_en: And when you recite the Qur'an, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যখন তুমি কুরআন তিলাওয়াত করো, তখন তোমার ও আখিরাতে অবিশ্বাসী লোকদের মাঝে আমি এক অদৃশ্য অন্তরাল স্থাপন করি।
ayahs.meta_bn: এনক্রিপ্টেড ফায়ারওয়াল ও আনঅথেন্টিকেটেড নোড ফিল্টারিং
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: حِجَابًا مَّسۡتُوۡرًا — ডেটা-এনক্রিপ্টেড ফায়ারওয়াল / অদৃশ্য অন্তরাল।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: حِجَابًا مَّسۡتُوۡرًا — ডেটা-এনক্রিপ্টেড ফায়ারওয়াল / অদৃশ্য অন্তরাল।

english_translations.sahih_international: And when you recite the Qur'an, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.
english_translations.pickthall: And when thou recitest the Qur'an we place between thee and those who believe not in the Hereafter a hidden barrier;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: When thou dost recite the Qur'an, We put, between thee and those who believe not in the Hereafter, a veil invisible:
english_translations.shakir: And when you recite the Quran, We place between you and those who do not believe in the hereafter a hidden barrier;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: When you recite the Quran We place a curtain as a barrier between you and those who do not believe in the life to come.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And when you (Muhammad SAW) recite the Quran, We put between you and those who believe not in the Hereafter, an invisible veil (or screen their hearts, so they hear or understand it not).
english_translations.arberry: When thou recitest the Koran, We place between thee, and those who do not believe in the world to come, a curtain obstructing,

ayahs.transliteration: wajaʿalnā ʿalā qulūbihim akinnatan an yafqahūhu wafī ādhānihim waqran wa-idhā dhakarta rabbaka fī l-qur'āni waḥdahu wallaw ʿalā adbārihim nufūran
ayahs.translation_bn: আর আমি তাদের অন্তরের উপর এক আবরণ দিয়ে দিয়েছি যাতে তারা কুরআন বুঝতে না পারে, আর তাদের কানে সৃষ্টি করেছি বধিরতা। আর যখন তুমি কুরআনে তোমার প্রতিপালকের একত্বের উল্লেখ কর, তখন তারা (সত্য থেকে) পালিয়ে পিছনে মুখ ঘুরিয়ে নেয়।
ayahs.translation_en: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn back in aversion.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn back in aversion.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি তাদের অন্তরের ওপর আবরণ দিয়ে দেই যাতে তারা তা বুঝতে না পারে এবং তাদের কানে বধিরতা দেই; আর যখন তুমি কুরআনে কেবল তোমার এক প্রতিপালকের কথা উল্লেখ করো, তখন তারা বিমুখ হয়ে পেছনে ফিরে চলে যায়।

english_translations.sahih_international: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn back in aversion.
english_translations.pickthall: And We place upon their hearts veils lest they should understand it, and in their ears a deafness; and when thou makest mention of thy Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn their backs in aversion.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And We put coverings over their hearts (and minds) lest they should understand the Qur'an, and deafness into their ears: when thou dost commemorate thy Lord and Him alone in the Qur'an, they turn on their backs, fleeing (from the Truth).
english_translations.shakir: And We have placed coverings on their hearts and a heaviness in their ears lest they understand it, and when you mention your Lord alone in the Quran they turn their backs in aversion.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We put a veil over their hearts so that they cannot understand it. We deafen their ears. When you mention your Lord in this Quran as One (Supreme Being), they run away.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And We have put coverings over their hearts lest, they should understand it (the Quran), and in their ears deafness. And when you make mention of your Lord Alone [La ilaha ill-Allah (none has the right to be worshipped but Allah) Islamic Monotheism] in the Quran, they turn on their backs, fleeing in extreme dislikeness.
english_translations.arberry: and We lay veils upon their hearts lest they understand it, and in their ears heaviness. And when thou mentionest thy Lord only in the Koran, they turn in their traces in aversion.

ayahs.transliteration: naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yastamiʿūna bihi idh yastamiʿūna ilayka wa-idh hum najwā idh yaqūlu l-ẓālimūna in tattabiʿūna illā rajulan masḥūran
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি ভাল করেই জানি তারা কান লাগিয়ে কী শুনে যখন তারা তোমার কথা কান লাগিয়ে শুনে। আর যখন তারা গোপনে পরস্পর আলোচনায় বসে তখন যালিমরা বলে, ‘তোমরা তো কেবল এক যাদুগ্রস্ত লোকের অনুসরণ করে চলেছ।’
ayahs.translation_en: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
ayahs.conventional_en: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা যখন কান পেতে তোমার কথা শোনে, তখন তারা কী উদ্দেশ্যে শোনে তা আমি খুব ভালো করেই জানি; আর যখন তারা গোপনে পরামর্শ করে, তখন জালেমরা বলে, ‘তোমরা তো কেবল এক জাদুগ্রস্ত ব্যক্তিরই অনুসরণ করছ’!

english_translations.sahih_international: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
english_translations.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they wish to hear when they give ear to thee and when they take secret counsel, when the evil-doers say: Ye follow but a man bewitched.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: We know best why it is they listen, when they listen to thee; and when they meet in private conference, behold, the wicked say, "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched!"
english_translations.shakir: We know best what they listen to when they listen to you, and when they take counsel secretly, when the unjust say: You follow only a man deprived of reason.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We know what they want to hear when they listen to you. They whisper to each other and say, "You are only following a bewitched person".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: We know best of what they listen to, when they listen to you. And when they take secret counsel, behold, the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.) say: "You follow none but a bewitched man."
english_translations.arberry: We know very well how they listen when they listen to thee, and when they conspire, when the evildoers say, 'You are only following a man bewitched!'

ayahs.transliteration: unẓur kayfa ḍarabū laka l-amthāla faḍallū falā yastaṭīʿūna sabīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: লক্ষ্য কর, তারা তোমার সম্পর্কে কেমন সব উদাহরণ দিচ্ছে! যার ফলে তারা পথহারা হয়ে গেছে আর তারা কক্ষনো পথ পাবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
ayahs.conventional_en: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
ayahs.conventional_bn: দেখো, তারা তোমার জন্য কী ধরনের উপমা উপস্থাপন করে! ফলে তারা পথভ্রষ্ট হয়েছে, কাজেই তারা কোনো সঠিক পথ পেতে সক্ষম নয়।
ayahs.meta_bn: ফলস অ্যানালজি ও পাথমাস্টারিং ফেইলিওর
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ضَرَبُوۡا لَكَ الۡاَمۡثَالَ — ডেটা-অ্যানালজি ক্রিয়েট করা; فَضَلُّوۡا — ডেটা-পাথ ডিভিয়েশন।

english_translations.sahih_international: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
english_translations.pickthall: See what similitudes they coin for thee, and thus are all astray, and cannot find a road!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: See what similes they strike for thee: but they have gone astray, and never can they find a way.
english_translations.shakir: See what they liken you to! So they have gone astray and cannot find the way.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Consider what they have called you. They have certainly gone astray and cannot find the right path.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: See what examples they have put forward for you. So they have gone astray, and never can they find a way.
english_translations.arberry: Behold, how they strike similitudes for thee, and go astray, and cannot find a way!

ayahs.transliteration: waqālū a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman warufātan a-innā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdan
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা বলে, ‘কী! আমরা হাড্ডি আর ধূলা-মাটিতে পরিণত হওয়ার পর কি এক নতুন সৃষ্টিরূপে উত্থিত হব?’
ayahs.translation_en: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
ayahs.conventional_en: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তারা বলে, ‘আমরা যখন অস্থি ও চূর্ণ-বিচূর্ণ ধূলিকণায় পরিণত হব, তখনও কি আমরা নতুন সৃষ্টিরূপে পুনরুত্থিত হব’?
ayahs.meta_bn: বায়ো-ডিকমিশনিং ও রিজেনারেশন স্কেপটিসিজম

english_translations.sahih_international: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
english_translations.pickthall: And they say: When we are bones and fragments, shall we forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: They say: "What! when we are reduced to bones and dust, should we really be raised up (to be) a new creation?"
english_translations.shakir: And they say: What! when we shall have become bones and decayed particles, shall we then certainly be raised up, being a new creation?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The pagans say, "When we become mere bones and dust, shall we then be brought back to life again?"
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And they say: "When we are bones and fragments (destroyed), should we really be resurrected (to be) a new creation?"
english_translations.arberry: They say, 'What, when we are bones and broken bits, shall we really be raised up again in a new creation?'

ayahs.transliteration: qul kūnū ḥijāratan aw ḥadīdan
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘তোমরা যদি পাথর কিংবা লোহাও হয়ে যাও,
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Be you stones or iron
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "Be you stones or iron
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো, ‘তোমরা পাথর হয়ে যাও অথবা লোহা’—

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "Be you stones or iron
english_translations.pickthall: Say: Be ye stones or iron
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "(Nay!) be ye stones or iron,
english_translations.shakir: Say: Become stones or iron,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say "Yes, even if you become rocks, iron,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW) "Be you stones or iron,"
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'Let you be stones, or iron,

ayahs.transliteration: aw khalqan mimmā yakburu fī ṣudūrikum fasayaqūlūna man yuʿīdunā quli alladhī faṭarakum awwala marratin fasayun'ghiḍūna ilayka ruūsahum wayaqūlūna matā huwa qul ʿasā an yakūna qarīban
ayahs.translation_bn: অথবা এমন কিছু যা তোমাদের ধারণায় (জীবিত হওয়া) খুবই কঠিন (তবুও তোমাদেরকে উঠানো হবে)।’ তারা বলবে, ‘কে আছে এমন যে আমাদেরকে পুনরায় জীবনে ফিরিয়ে আনবে?’ বল, ‘তিনিই যিনি তোমাদেরকে প্রথমবার সৃষ্টি করেছেন।’ তখন তারা (ঠাট্টার ছলে) তোমার সামনে মাথা নাড়বে আর বলবে, ‘সেটা কখন ঘটবে?’ বল, ‘হতে পারে সেটা শীঘ্রই ঘটবে।’
ayahs.translation_en: Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -
ayahs.conventional_en: Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -
ayahs.conventional_bn: অথবা এমন কোনো সৃষ্টি যা তোমাদের ধারণায় আরও বেশি কঠিন; অতঃপর তারা বলবে, ‘কে আমাদের পুনরায় ফিরিয়ে আনবে?’ বলো, ‘তিনিই, যিনি তোমাদের প্রথমবার সৃষ্টি করেছেন’; তখন তারা তোমার সামনে মাথা নাড়বে এবং বলবে, ‘তা কবে হবে?’ বলো, ‘হতে পারে তা খুবই নিকটবর্তী’!

english_translations.sahih_international: Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -
english_translations.pickthall: Or some created thing that is yet greater in your thoughts! Then they will say: Who shall bring us back (to life). Say: He Who created you at the first. Then will they shake their heads at thee, and say: When will it be? Say: It will perhaps be soon;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "Or created matter which, in your minds, is hardest (to be raised up),- (Yet shall ye be raised up)!" then will they say: "Who will cause us to return?" Say: "He who created you first!" Then will they wag their heads towards thee, and say, "When will that be?" Say, "May be it will be quite soon!
english_translations.shakir: Or some other creature of those which are too hard (to receive life) in your minds! But they will say: Who will return us? Say: Who created you at first. Still they will shake their heads at you and say: When will it be? Say: Maybe it has drawn nigh.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: or anything that you think is harder to be brought to life." They will soon ask, "Who will bring us back to life?" Say,"The One who created you in the first place." They will shake their heads and say, "When will He bring us back to life?" Say, "Perhaps very soon.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "Or some created thing that is yet greater (or harder) in your breasts (thoughts to be resurrected, even then you shall be resurrected)" Then, they will say: "Who shall bring us back (to life)?" Say: "He Who created you first!" Then, they will shake their heads at you and say: "When will that be?" Say: "Perhaps it is near!"
english_translations.arberry: or some creation yet more monstrous in your minds!' Then they will say, 'Who will bring us back?' Say: 'He who originated you the first time.' Then they will shake their heads at thee, and they will say, 'When will it be?' Say: 'It is possible that it may be nigh,

ayahs.transliteration: yawma yadʿūkum fatastajībūna biḥamdihi wataẓunnūna in labith'tum illā qalīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: যে দিন তিনি তোমাদেরকে ডাকবেন আর তোমরা তাঁর প্রশংসা করতে করতে তাঁর ডাকে সাড়া দিবে আর তোমরা ধারণা করবে যে, তোমরা খুব অল্প সময়ই অবস্থান করেছিলে।
ayahs.translation_en: On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
ayahs.conventional_en: On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
ayahs.conventional_bn: যেদিন তিনি তোমাদের ডাকবেন, অতঃপর তোমরা তাঁর প্রশংসার সাথে তাঁর ডাকে সাড়া দেবে এবং তোমরা ধারণা করবে যে, তোমরা অল্প সময়ই অবস্থান করেছিলে।

english_translations.sahih_international: On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."
english_translations.pickthall: A day when He will call you and ye will answer with His praise, and ye will think that ye have tarried but a little while.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "It will be on a Day when He will call you, and ye will answer (His call) with (words of) His praise, and ye will think that ye tarried but a little while!"
english_translations.shakir: On the day when He will call you forth, then shall you obey Him, giving Him praise, and you will think that you tarried but a little (while).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when He will call you, you will answer Him with praise and think that you have tarried for only a little while."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: On the Day when He will call you, and you will answer (His Call) with (words of) His Praise and Obedience, and you will think that you have stayed (in this world) but a little while!
english_translations.arberry: on the day when He will call you, and you will answer praising Him, and you will think you have but tarried a little.'

ayahs.translation_bn: আমার বান্দাদেরকে বলতে বল এমন কথা যা খুবই উত্তম। শয়তান মানুষের মাঝে ঝগড়া-বিভেদ-বিশৃঙ্খলা সৃষ্টি করে, শয়তান হল মানুষের প্রকাশ্য দুশমন।
ayahs.translation_en: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.
ayahs.conventional_en: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমার বান্দাদের বলো, তারা যেন এমন কথা বলে যা সর্বোত্তম; নিশ্চয়ই শয়তান তাদের মাঝে বিভেদ সৃষ্টি করতে চায়; নিশ্চয়ই শয়তান মানুষের প্রকাশ্য শত্রু।

english_translations.sahih_international: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.
english_translations.pickthall: Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say to My servants that they should (only) say those things that are best: for Satan doth sow dissensions among them: For Satan is to man an avowed enemy.
english_translations.shakir: And say to My servants (that) they speak that which is best; surely the Shaitan sows dissensions among them; surely the Shaitan is an open enemy to man.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell My servants to say what is best. Satan sows dissension among them; he is the sworn enemy of human beings.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And say to My slaves (i.e. the true believers of Islamic Monotheism) that they should (only) say those words that are the best. (Because) Shaitan (Satan) verily, sows disagreements among them. Surely, Shaitan (Satan) is to man a plain enemy.
english_translations.arberry: And say to My servants, that they say words that are kindlier. For surely Satan provokes strife between them, and Satan is ever a manifest foe to man.

ayahs.transliteration: rabbukum aʿlamu bikum in yasha yarḥamkum aw in yasha yuʿadhib'kum wamā arsalnāka ʿalayhim wakīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমাদের প্রতিপালক তোমাদেরকে খুব ভাল ক’রেই জানেন। তিনি ইচ্ছে করলে তোমাদের প্রতি অনুগ্রহ করবেন, আর ইচ্ছে করলে তোমাদেরকে শাস্তি দেবেন; আমি তোমাকে (হে নাবী!) তাদের কাজকর্মের জন্য দায়িত্বশীল করে পাঠাইনি।

words.translation_en: He will have mercy upon you

ayahs.translation_en: Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a manager.
ayahs.conventional_en: Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a manager.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমাদের প্রতিপালক তোমাদের সম্পর্কে সম্যক অবগত; তিনি ইচ্ছা করলে তোমাদের প্রতি দয়া করবেন অথবা ইচ্ছা করলে তোমাদের শাস্তি দেবেন; আর আমি তোমাকে তাদের ওপর অভিভাবক করে পাঠাইনি।
ayahs.meta_bn: সেন্ট্রাল টেলিমেট্রি ও নন-প্রক্সি মেসেঞ্জার রোল

english_translations.sahih_international: Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a manager.
english_translations.pickthall: Your Lord is Best Aware of you. If He will, He will have mercy on you, or if He will, He will punish you. We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) as a warden over them.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: It is your Lord that knoweth you best: If He please, He granteth you mercy, or if He please, punishment: We have not sent thee to be a disposer of their affairs for them.
english_translations.shakir: Your Lord knows you best; He will have mercy on you if He pleases, or He will chastise you if He pleases; and We have not sent you as being in charge of them.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord knows better than you (people). He will have mercy on you or will punish you as He wills. We have not sent you to watch over them. Your Lord knows best about those in the heavens and the earth.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Your Lord knows you best, if He will, He will have mercy on you, or if He will, He will punish you. And We have not sent you (O Muhammad SAW) as a guardian over them.
english_translations.arberry: Your Lord knows you very well; if He will, He will have mercy on you, or, if He will, He will chastise you. We sent thee not to be a guardian over them.

ayahs.transliteration: warabbuka aʿlamu biman fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi walaqad faḍḍalnā baʿḍa l-nabiyīna ʿalā baʿḍin waātaynā dāwūda zabūran
ayahs.translation_bn: আসমান আর যমীনে যারা আছে তোমার প্রতিপালক তাদেরকে ভাল ক’রেই জানেন। আমি নাবীগণের কতককে অন্যদের উপর মর্যাদা দান করেছি আর দাঊদকে দিয়েছি যাবূর।
ayahs.translation_en: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
ayahs.conventional_en: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আসমান ও যমীনে যারা আছে, তোমার প্রতিপালক তাদের সম্পর্কে সম্যক অবগত; আর আমি অবশ্যই নবীদের কতককে কতকের ওপর শ্রেষ্ঠত্ব দিয়েছি এবং দাউদকে যাবুর প্রদান করেছি।
ayahs.meta_bn: হায়ারার্কিক্যাল নোড প্রায়োরিটাইজেশন ও স্ক্রিপ্ট অ্যালোকেশন

english_translations.sahih_international: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
english_translations.pickthall: And thy Lord is Best Aware of all who are in the heavens and the earth. And we preferred some of the prophets above others, and unto David We gave the Psalms.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And it is your Lord that knoweth best all beings that are in the heavens and on earth: We did bestow on some prophets more (and other) gifts than on others: and We gave to David (the gift of) the Psalms.
english_translations.shakir: And your Lord best knows those who are in the heavens and the earth; and certainly We have made some of the prophets to excel others, and to Dawood We gave a scripture.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have given preference to some Prophets over others and We gave the psalms to David.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And your Lord knows best all who are in the heavens and the earth. And indeed, We have preferred some of the Prophets above others, and to Dawud (David) We gave the Zabur (Psalms).
english_translations.arberry: And thy Lord knows very well all who are in the heavens and the earth; and We have preferred some Prophets over others; and We gave to David Psalms.

ayahs.transliteration: quli id'ʿū alladhīna zaʿamtum min dūnihi falā yamlikūna kashfa l-ḍuri ʿankum walā taḥwīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘তোমরা আল্লাহ ছাড়া যাদেরকে ইলাহ মনে কর তাদেরকে ডাক, (ডাকলেও দেখতে পাবে) তারা তোমাদের দুঃখ-বেদনা দূর করতে বা বদলাতে সক্ষম নয়।
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো, ‘তোমরা আল্লাহ ছাড়া যাদেরকে (ইলাহ) মনে করো তাদেরকে ডাকো; অতঃপর তোমরা দেখবে যে, তোমাদের দুঃখ-কষ্ট দূর করার কিংবা তা পরিবর্তন করার কোনো ক্ষমতাই তাদের নেই’!

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else]."
english_translations.pickthall: Say: Cry unto those (saints and angels) whom ye assume (to be gods) beside Him, yet they have no power to rid you of misfortune nor to change.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "Call on those - besides Him - whom ye fancy: they have neither the power to remove your troubles from you nor to change them."
english_translations.shakir: Say: Call on those whom you assert besides Him, so they shall not control the removal of distress from you nor (its) transference.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them, "Seek help from those whom you consider equal to God. They are not able to remove or change your hardships".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "Call unto those besides Him whom you pretend [to be gods like angels, Iesa (Jesus), 'Uzair (Ezra), etc.]. They have neither the power to remove the adversity from you nor even to shift it from you to another person."
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'Call on those you asserted apart from Him; they have no power to remove affliction from you, or to transfer it.

ayahs.transliteration: ulāika alladhīna yadʿūna yabtaghūna ilā rabbihimu l-wasīlata ayyuhum aqrabu wayarjūna raḥmatahu wayakhāfūna ʿadhābahu inna ʿadhāba rabbika kāna maḥdhūran
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা যাদেরকে ডাকে তারা নিজেরাই তো তাদের প্রতিপালকের নিকট পৌঁছার পথ অনুসন্ধান করে যে, কে তাঁর অধিক নিকটবর্তী হতে পারবে, আর তাঁর দয়া প্রত্যাশা করে এবং তাঁর শাস্তিকে ভয় করে। তোমার প্রতিপালকের শাস্তি তো ভয় করার মতই।
ayahs.translation_en: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
ayahs.conventional_en: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা যাদেরকে আহ্বান করে, তারা নিজেরাও তো তাদের প্রতিপালকের নৈকট্য লাভের উপায় সন্ধান করে—যে তাদের মধ্যে কে তাঁর সর্বাধিক নিকটবর্তী হবে; এবং তারা তাঁর দয়ার আশা করে ও তাঁর শাস্তিকে ভয় করে; নিশ্চয়ই তোমার প্রতিপালকের শাস্তি ভীতিপ্রদ।

english_translations.sahih_international: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
english_translations.pickthall: Those unto whom they cry seek the way of approach to their Lord, which of them shall be the nearest; they hope for His mercy and they fear His doom. Lo! the doom of thy Lord is to be shunned.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Those whom they call upon do desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord, - even those who are nearest: they hope for His Mercy and fear His Wrath: for the Wrath of thy Lord is something to take heed of.
english_translations.shakir: Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord-- whoever of them is nearest-- and they hope for His mercy and fear His chastisement; surely the chastisement of your Lord is a thing to be cautious of.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Those whom they worship seek to find intercessors for themselves with God. (They try to find out which of the intercessors) are closer to God. They have hope for His mercy and fear of His punishment; the punishment of your Lord is awesome.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Those whom they call upon [like 'Iesa (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary), 'Uzair (Ezra), angel, etc.] desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord (Allah), as to which of them should be the nearest and they ['Iesa (Jesus), 'Uzair (Ezra), angels, etc.] hope for His Mercy and fear His Torment. Verily, the Torment of your Lord is something to be afraid of!
english_translations.arberry: Those they call upon are themselves seeking the means to come to their Lord, which of them shall be nearer; they hope for His mercy, and fear His chastisement. Surely thy Lord's chastisement is a thing to beware of.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-in min qaryatin illā naḥnu muh'likūhā qabla yawmi l-qiyāmati aw muʿadhibūhā ʿadhāban shadīdan kāna dhālika fī l-kitābi masṭūran
ayahs.translation_bn: এমন কোন জনবসতি নেই যাকে আমি ক্বিয়ামাত দিনের পূর্বে ধ্বংস করব না কিংবা তাকে কঠিন শাস্তি দিব না, এটা (আল্লাহর) কিতাবে লিপিবদ্ধ আছে।
ayahs.translation_en: And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed.
ayahs.conventional_en: And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর এমন কোনো জনপদ নেই—যা আমি কিয়ামত দিবসের পূর্বেই ধ্বংস করব না অথবা তাকে কঠোর শাস্তি দেব না; এটি তো কিতাবে লিপিবদ্ধ রয়েছে।

english_translations.sahih_international: And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed.
english_translations.pickthall: There is not a township but We shall destroy it ere the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with dire punishment. That is set forth in the Book (of Our decrees).
english_translations.yusuf_ali: There is not a population but We shall destroy it before the Day of Judgment or punish it with a dreadful Penalty: that is written in the (eternal) Record.
english_translations.shakir: And there is not a town but We will destroy it before the day of resurrection or chastise it with a severe chastisement; this is written in the Divine ordinance.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The decree that all the towns were to be destroyed or afflicted with severe punishment was already written in the Book before the Day of Judgment.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And there is not a town (population) but We shall destroy it before the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with a severe torment. That is written in the Book (of our Decrees)
english_translations.arberry: No city is there, but We shall destroy it before the Day of Resurrection, or We shall chastise it with a terrible chastisement; that is in the Book inscribed.

ayahs.transliteration: wamā manaʿanā an nur'sila bil-āyāti illā an kadhaba bihā l-awalūna waātaynā thamūda l-nāqata mub'ṣiratan faẓalamū bihā wamā nur'silu bil-āyāti illā takhwīfan
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি নিদর্শন প্রেরণ করা হতে এজন্য বিরত থাকি যে, পূর্বের লোকেরা তা মিথ্যা মনে ক’রে প্রত্যাখ্যান করেছিল। আমি সামূদ জাতির নিকট উষ্ট্রী পাঠিয়েছিলাম এক প্রত্যক্ষ নিদর্শন হিসেবে কিন্তু তারা তার প্রতি যুলম করল; ভয় প্রদর্শনের উদ্দেশ্যেই কেবল আমি নিদর্শন পাঠিয়ে থাকি।
ayahs.translation_en: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.
ayahs.conventional_en: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর দৃশ্যমান নিদর্শনসমূহ প্রেরণে আমাকে কেবল এটাই বিরত রেখেছে যে, পূর্ববর্তীরা সেগুলোকে অস্বীকার করেছিল; আর আমি সামূদ জাতিকে স্পষ্ট নিদর্শন হিসেবে উষ্ট্রী দিয়েছিলাম, অতঃপর তারা তার প্রতি জুলুম করেছিল; আর আমি কেবল ভীতি প্রদর্শনের জন্যই নিদর্শনসমূহ প্রেরণ করি।

english_translations.sahih_international: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.
english_translations.pickthall: Naught hindereth Us from sending portents save that the folk of old denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel - a clear portent save to warn.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And We refrain from sending the signs, only because the men of former generations treated them as false: We sent the she-camel to the Thamud to open their eyes, but they treated her wrongfully: We only send the Signs by way of terror (and warning from evil).
english_translations.shakir: And nothing could have hindered Us that We should send signs except that the ancients rejected them; and We gave to Samood the she-camel-- a manifest sign-- but on her account they did injustice, and We do not send signs but to make (men) fear.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We did not abstain from sending miracles to any of Our Messengers. These miracles were called lies by the people who lived in ancient times. To the people of Thamud, We sent the she-camel as a visible miracle and they did injustice to it. We only send miracles as warnings.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And nothing stops Us from sending the Ayat (proofs, evidences, signs) but that the people of old denied them. And We sent the she-camel to Thamud as a clear sign, but they did her wrong. And We sent not the signs except to warn, and to make them afraid (of destruction).
english_translations.arberry: Naught prevented Us from sending the signs but that the ancients cried lies to them; and We brought Thamood the She-camel visible, but they did her wrong. And We do not send the signs, except to frighten.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idh qul'nā laka inna rabbaka aḥāṭa bil-nāsi wamā jaʿalnā l-ru'yā allatī araynāka illā fit'natan lilnnāsi wal-shajarata l-malʿūnata fī l-qur'āni wanukhawwifuhum famā yazīduhum illā ṭugh'yānan kabīran
ayahs.translation_bn: স্মরণ কর, আমি তোমাকে বলেছিলাম যে, তোমার রবব মানুষদেরকে ঘিরে রেখেছেন। আমি তোমাকে (মি’রাজের মাধ্যমে) যে দৃশ্য দেখিয়েছি তা এবং কুরআনে উল্লেখিত অভিশপ্ত (জাক্কুম) গাছটিও মানুষদেরকে পরীক্ষা করার জন্য (যে কারা তা বিশ্বাস ক’রে নেককার হয় আর কারা তা অবিশ্বাস ক’রে পাপী হয়)। আমি তাদেরকে ভয় দেখাই ও সাবধান করি, কিন্তু তাতে তাদের চরম অবাধ্যতাই বৃদ্ধি পায়।

words.translation_bn: এবং আমরা তাদের ভয় প্রদর্শন করি

ayahs.translation_en: And [remember, O Muhammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur'an. And We threaten them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
ayahs.conventional_en: And [remember, O Muhammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur'an. And We threaten them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর স্মরণ করো, যখন আমি তোমাকে বলেছিলাম যে, নিশ্চয়ই তোমার প্রতিপালক মানুষকে পরিবেষ্টন করে রেখেছেন; আর আমি তোমাকে যে দৃশ্য দেখিয়েছিলাম তা কেবল মানুষের জন্য পরীক্ষার উদ্দেশ্যেই ছিল এবং কুরআনে উল্লেখিত অভিশপ্ত বৃক্ষটিও; আর আমি তাদেরকে ভয় দেখাই, কিন্তু তা তাদের ঘোর অবাধ্যতাই বৃদ্ধি করে।

english_translations.sahih_international: And [remember, O Muhammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur'an. And We threaten them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
english_translations.pickthall: And (it was a warning) when we told thee: Lo! thy Lord encompasseth mankind, and We appointed the sight which We showed thee as an ordeal for mankind, and (likewise) the Accursed Tree in the Qur'an. We warn them, but it increaseth them in naught save gross impiety.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Behold! We told thee that thy Lord doth encompass mankind round about: We granted the vision which We showed thee, but as a trial for men,- as also the Cursed Tree (mentioned) in the Qur'an: We put terror (and warning) into them, but it only increases their inordinate transgression!
english_translations.shakir: And when We said to you: Surely your Lord encompasses men; and We did not make the vision which We showed you but a trial for men and the cursed tree in the Quran as well; and We cause them to fear, but it only adds to their great inordinacy.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), We told you that your Lord has encompassed all mankind. We made the vision which We showed you and the condemned tree, mentioned in the Quran, as a trial for the human being. Even though We warn them, it only increases their rebellion.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And (remember) when We told you: "Verily! Your Lord has encompassed mankind (i.e. they are in His Grip)." And We made not the vision which we showed you (O Muhammad as an actual eye-witness and not as a dream on the night of Al-Isra') but a trial for mankind, and likewise the accursed tree (Zaqqum, mentioned) in the Quran. We warn and make them afraid but it only increases them in naught save great disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allah.
english_translations.arberry: And when We said to thee, 'Surely thy Lord encompasses men,' and We made the vision that We showed thee and the tree cursed in the Koran to be only a trial for men; and We frighten them, but it only increases them in great insolence.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idh qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa qāla a-asjudu liman khalaqta ṭīnan
ayahs.translation_bn: স্মরণ কর, যখন আমি ফেরেশতাগণকে বলেছিলাম, ‘আদামকে সাজদাহ কর তখন ইবলিশ ছাড়া সবাই তাকে সাজদাহ করল। সে বলেছিল, ‘আমি কি তাকে সাজদাহ করব যাকে তুমি মাটি থেকে পয়দা করেছ?’
ayahs.translation_en: And [mention] when We said to the angles, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"
ayahs.conventional_en: And [mention] when We said to the angles, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর স্মরণ করো, যখন আমি ফেরেশতাদের বললাম, ‘আদমের প্রতি সিজদা করো’, তখন ইবলিস ছাড়া তারা সবাই সিজদা করল; সে বলল, ‘আমি কি তাকে সিজদা করব—যাকে তুমি কাদা মাটি দিয়ে সৃষ্টি করেছ’?

english_translations.sahih_international: And [mention] when We said to the angles, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"
english_translations.pickthall: And when We said unto the angels: Fall down prostrate before Adam and they fell prostrate all save Iblis, he said: Shall I fall prostrate before that which Thou hast created of clay?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Behold! We said to the angels: "Bow down unto Adam": They bowed down except Iblis: He said, "Shall I bow down to one whom Thou didst create from clay?"
english_translations.shakir: And when We said to the angels: Make obeisance to Adam; they made obeisance, but Iblis (did it not). He said: Shall I make obeisance to him whom Thou hast created of dust?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: When We told the angels to prostrate before Adam, they all obeyed, except Iblis who said, "Should I prostrate before one whom You have created out of clay?"
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And (remember) when We said to the angels: "Prostrate unto Adam." They prostrated except Iblis (Satan). He said: "Shall I prostrate to one whom You created from clay?"
english_translations.arberry: And when We said to the angels, 'Bow yourselves to Adam'; so they bowed themselves, save Iblis; he said,, 'Shall I bow myself unto one Thou hast created of clay?'

ayahs.transliteration: qāla ara-aytaka hādhā alladhī karramta ʿalayya la-in akhartani ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati la-aḥtanikanna dhurriyyatahu illā qalīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: সে বলল, ‘আপনি কি ব্যাপারটা খেয়াল করেছেন যে, আপনি এ ব্যক্তিকে আমার উপর সম্মান দিচ্ছেন! আপনি যদি আমাকে ক্বিয়ামাতের দিন পর্যন্ত সময় দেন, তাহলে আমি অল্প কিছু বাদে তার বংশধরদেরকে অবশ্য অবশ্যই আমার কর্তৃত্বাধীনে এনে ফেলব।’
ayahs.translation_en: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."
ayahs.conventional_en: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."
ayahs.conventional_bn: সে বলল, ‘আমাকে দেখুন, আপনি যাকে আমার ওপর শ্রেষ্ঠত্ব দিয়েছেন! আপনি যদি আমাকে কিয়ামতের দিন পর্যন্ত অবকাশ দেন, তবে আমি অল্প কয়েকজন ছাড়া তার বংশধরদের সম্পূর্ণ বশীভূত করে ফেলব’!

english_translations.sahih_international: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."
english_translations.pickthall: He said: Seest Thou this (creature) whom Thou hast honoured above me, if Thou give me grace until the Day of Resurrection I verily will seize his seed, save but a few.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: He said: "Seest Thou? this is the one whom Thou hast honoured above me! If Thou wilt but respite me to the Day of Judgment, I will surely bring his descendants under my sway - all but a few!"
english_translations.shakir: He said: Tell me, is this he whom Thou hast honored above me? If Thou shouldst respite me to the day of resurrection, I will most certainly cause his progeny to perish except a few.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He continued, "Remember, this one whom you have honored more than me I shall bring him and most of his offspring under my sway if you will give me respite until the Day of Judgment."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: [Iblis (Satan)] said: "See? This one whom You have honoured above me, if You give me respite (keep me alive) to the Day of Resurrection, I will surely seize and mislead his offspring (by sending them astray) all but a few!"
english_translations.arberry: He said, 'What thinkest Thou? This whom Thou hast honoured above me -- if Thou deferrest me to the Day of Resurrection I shall assuredly master his seed, save a few.'

ayahs.transliteration: qāla idh'hab faman tabiʿaka min'hum fa-inna jahannama jazāukum jazāan mawfūran
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ বললেন, ‘যাও, তাদের মধ্যে যারা তোমাকে মেনে চলবে, জাহান্নামই হবে তোমাদের সকলের প্রতিফল, পূর্ণ প্রতিফল।
ayahs.translation_en: [Allah] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of you - an ample recompense.
ayahs.conventional_en: [Allah] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of you - an ample recompense.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আল্লাহ বললেন, ‘যাও! তাদের মধ্যে যারা তোমার অনুসরণ করবে, তবে নিশ্চয়ই জাহান্নামই হবে তোমাদের সকলের প্রতিফল—পরিপূর্ণ প্রতিফল’।
ayahs.meta_bn: ডেটা-ডিসকানেক্ট ও থার্মোডাইনামিক ক্র্যাশ-জোন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: اذْهَبْ — ডেটা-ডিসকানেক্ট / প্রস্থান করো; تَبِعَكَ — ডেটা-ফলো / অনুসরণ করা; جَهَنَّمَ — থার্মোডাইনামিক ক্র্যাশ-জোন / জাহান্নাম; جَزَاءً مَّوْفُورًا — ডেটা-পূর্ণ প্রতিফল / পর্যাপ্ত ও পরিপূর্ণ দণ্ড।

english_translations.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of you - an ample recompense.
english_translations.pickthall: He said: Go, and whosoever of them followeth thee - lo! hell will be your payment, ample payment.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (Allah) said: "Go thy way; if any of them follow thee, verily Hell will be the recompense of you (all)- an ample recompense.
english_translations.shakir: He said: Be gone! for whoever of them will follow you, then surely hell is your recompense, a full recompense:
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: God said, "Go away. All those who follow you will have hell as ample recompense for their deeds.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (Allah) said: "Go, and whosoever of them follows you, surely! Hell will be the recompense of you (all) an ample recompense.
english_translations.arberry: Said He, 'Depart! Those of them that follow thee -- surely Gehenna shall be your recompense, an ample recompense!

ayahs.transliteration: wa-is'tafziz mani is'taṭaʿta min'hum biṣawtika wa-ajlib ʿalayhim bikhaylika warajilika washārik'hum fī l-amwāli wal-awlādi waʿid'hum wamā yaʿiduhumu l-shayṭānu illā ghurūran
ayahs.translation_bn: তাদের মধ্যে তুমি যাকে পার উস্কে দাও তোমার কথা দিয়ে, তোমার অশ্বারোহী আর পদাতিক বাহিনী দিয়ে তুমি আক্রমণ চালাও, আর তাদের ধন-সম্পদ ও সন্তানাদিতে ভাগ বসিয়ে দাও (যথেচ্ছভাবে সম্পদ উপার্জন ও ব্যয় করার পরামর্শ দিয়ে আর সন্তান কামনা ও প্রতিপালনে আল্লাহর বিধান লঙ্ঘনের উপদেশ দিয়ে) আর তাদেরকে প্রতিশ্রুতি দাও।’ শয়তান তাদেরকে যে প্রতিশ্রুতি দেয় তাতো ছলনা ছাড়া আর কিছুই নয়।
ayahs.translation_en: And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
ayahs.conventional_en: And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
ayahs.conventional_bn: ‘আর তাদের মধ্যে যাকে পারো তোমার কণ্ঠ দিয়ে পদস্খলিত করো এবং তোমার অশ্বারোহী ও পদাতিক বাহিনী নিয়ে তাদের ওপর আক্রমণ চালাও, আর তাদের ধন-সম্পদ ও সন্তান-সন্ততিতে অংশীদার হও এবং তাদেরকে প্রতিশ্রুতি দাও’; আর শয়তান তাদেরকে প্রতারণা ছাড়া অন্য কোনো প্রতিশ্রুতি দেয় না।

english_translations.sahih_international: And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
english_translations.pickthall: And excite any of them whom thou canst with thy voice, and urge thy horse and foot against them, and be a partner in their wealth and children, and promise them. Satan promiseth them only to deceive.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "Lead to destruction those whom thou canst among them, with thy (seductive) voice; make assaults on them with thy cavalry and thy infantry; mutually share with them wealth and children; and make promises to them." But Satan promises them nothing but deceit.
english_translations.shakir: And beguile whomsoever of them you can with your voice, and collect against them your forces riding and on foot, and share with them in wealth and children, and hold out promises to them; and the Shaitan makes not promises to them but to deceive:
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Draw anyone of them you can into sin by your voice and by your cavalry and infantry, share their property and children with them and make promises to them. Your promises are all lies.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "And Istafziz [literally means: befool them gradually] those whom you can among them with your voice (i.e. songs, music, and any other call for Allah's disobedience), make assaults on them with your cavalry and your infantry, mutually share with them wealth and children (by tempting them to earn money by illegal ways usury, etc., or by committing illegal sexual intercourse, etc.), and make promises to them." But Satan promises them nothing but deceit.
english_translations.arberry: And startle whomsoever of them thou canst with thy voice; and rally against them thy horsemen and thy foot, and share with them in their wealth and their children, and promise them!' But Satan promises them naught, except delusion.

ayahs.transliteration: inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sul'ṭānun wakafā birabbika wakīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: ‘আমার বান্দাহদের ব্যাপার হল, তাদের উপর তোমার কোন আধিপত্য চলবে না।’ কর্ম সম্পাদনে তোমার প্রতিপালকই যথেষ্ট।
ayahs.translation_en: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
ayahs.conventional_en: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
ayahs.conventional_bn: ‘নিশ্চয়ই আমার বান্দাদের ওপর তোমার কোনো আধিপত্য নেই’; আর কর্মবিধায়ক হিসেবে তোমার প্রতিপালকই যথেষ্ট।
