english_translations.sahih_international: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
english_translations.pickthall: Lo! My (faithful) bondmen - over them thou hast no power, and thy Lord sufficeth as (their) guardian.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "As for My servants, no authority shalt thou have over them:" Enough is thy Lord for a Disposer of affairs.
english_translations.shakir: Surely (as for) My servants, you have no authority over them; and your Lord is sufficient as a Protector.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: You have no authority over My servants. Your Lord is a Sufficient Protector."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "Verily! My slaves (i.e. the true believers of Islamic Monotheism), you have no authority over them. And All-Sufficient is your Lord as a Guardian."
english_translations.arberry: 'Surely over My servants thou shalt have no authority.' Thy Lord suffices as a guardian.

ayahs.transliteration: rabbukumu alladhī yuz'jī lakumu l-ful'ka fī l-baḥri litabtaghū min faḍlihi innahu kāna bikum raḥīman
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমাদের (প্রকৃত) প্রতিপালক তো তিনিই, যিনি সমুদ্রে তোমাদের জন্য সুস্থিরভাবে নৌযান পরিচালনা করেন, যাতে তোমরা তাঁর অনুগ্রহ সন্ধান করতে পার, তিনি তোমাদের প্রতি বড়ই দয়ালু।
ayahs.translation_en: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.
ayahs.conventional_en: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমাদের প্রতিপালক তো তিনিই, যিনি সমুদ্রে তোমাদের জন্য নৌযান চালনা করেন—যাতে তোমরা তাঁর অনুগ্রহ অন্বেষণ করতে পারো; নিশ্চয়ই তিনি তোমাদের প্রতি পরম দয়ালু।

english_translations.sahih_international: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.
english_translations.pickthall: (O mankind), your Lord is He Who driveth for you the ship upon the sea that ye may seek of His bounty. Lo! He was ever Merciful toward you.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Your Lord is He That maketh the Ship go smoothly for you through the sea, in order that ye may seek of his Bounty. For he is unto you most Merciful.
english_translations.shakir: Your Lord is He Who speeds the ships for you in the sea that you may seek of His grace; surely He is ever Merciful to you.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord who causes the ships to sail on the sea so that you may seek His bounty is certainly All-merciful to you.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Your Lord is He Who drives the ship for you through the sea, in order that you may seek of His Bounty. Truly! He is Ever Most Merciful towards you.
english_translations.arberry: Your Lord it is who drives for you the ships on the sea that you may seek His bounty; surely He is All-compassionate towards you.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā massakumu l-ḍuru fī l-baḥri ḍalla man tadʿūna illā iyyāhu falammā najjākum ilā l-bari aʿraḍtum wakāna l-insānu kafūran
ayahs.translation_bn: সমুদ্রে যখন বিপদ তোমাদেরকে পেয়ে বসে, তখন তাঁকে ছাড়া অন্য যাদেরকে তোমরা (উপাস্য ভেবে) আহবান কর তারা (তখন তোমাদের মন থেকে) হারিয়ে যায়। অতঃপর তিনি যখন তোমাদেরকে স্থলে এনে বাঁচিয়ে দেন, তখন তোমরা মুখ ফিরিয়ে নাও। মানুষ হল বড়ই অকৃতজ্ঞ।
ayahs.translation_en: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful.
ayahs.conventional_en: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর সমুদ্রে যখন তোমাদের কোনো বিপদ স্পর্শ করে, তখন একমাত্র আল্লাহ ছাড়া তোমরা যাদের ডাকতে তারা সবাই হারিয়ে যায়; অতঃপর তিনি যখন তোমাদের উদ্ধার করে স্থলে নিয়ে আসেন, তখন তোমরা মুখ ফিরিয়ে নাও; আর মানুষ বড়ই অকৃতজ্ঞ।

english_translations.sahih_international: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful.
english_translations.pickthall: And when harm toucheth you upon the sea, all unto whom ye cry (for succour) fail save Him (alone), but when He bringeth you safe to land, ye turn away, for man was ever thankless.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: When distress seizes you at sea, those that ye call upon - besides Himself - leave you in the lurch! but when He brings you back safe to land, ye turn away (from Him). Most ungrateful is man!
english_translations.shakir: And when distress afflicts you in the sea, away go those whom you call on except He; but when He brings you safe to the land, you turn aside; and man is ever ungrateful.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: If you are afflicted by hardships in the middle of the sea, it would be an error to call anyone other than Him for help. When God saves you from such difficulties, you turn away from Him. The human being has always been ungrateful.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And when harm touches you upon the sea, those that you call upon besides Him vanish from you except Him (Allah Alone). But when He brings you safely to land, you turn away (from Him). And man is ever ungrateful.
english_translations.arberry: And when affliction visits you upon the sea, then there go astray those on whom you call except Him; and when He delivers you to land, you turn away; man is ever unthankful.

ayahs.transliteration: afa-amintum an yakhsifa bikum jāniba l-bari aw yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban thumma lā tajidū lakum wakīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা কি নির্ভয় হয়ে গেছ যে তিনি তোমাদেরকে স্থলভাগেই যমীনের মধ্যে ধ্বসিয়ে দিবেন না, কিংবা তোমাদের উপর শিলা বর্ষণকারী ঝড়ো হাওয়া পাঠাবেন না? এমতাবস্থায় তোমাদের রক্ষাকারী কাউকে তোমরা পাবে না।

words.translation_en: He will not cause to swallow

ayahs.translation_en: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
ayahs.conventional_en: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তবে কি তোমরা এ বিষয়ে সম্পূর্ণ নির্ভয় হয়ে গেছ যে, তিনি স্থলভাগের কোনো অংশসহ তোমাদের ধসিয়ে দেবেন না, কিংবা তোমাদের ওপর পাথরবাহী ঝড় প্রেরণ করবেন না? তখন তোমরা নিজেদের কোনো অভিভাবক পাবে না!

english_translations.sahih_international: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
english_translations.pickthall: Feel ye then secure that He will not cause a slope of the land to engulf you, or send a sand-storm upon you, and then ye will find that ye have no protector?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Do ye then feel secure that He will not cause you to be swallowed up beneath the earth when ye are on land, or that He will not send against you a violent tornado (with showers of stones) so that ye shall find no one to carry out your affairs for you?
english_translations.shakir: What! Do you then feel secure that He will not cause a tract of land to engulf you or send on you a tornado? Then you shall not find a protector for yourselves.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do you feel secure that We will not cause a part of the land to sink or engulf you with sand storms when you would find no one to protect you?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Do you then feel secure that He will not cause a side of the land to swallow you up, or that He will not send against you a violent sand-storm? Then, you shall find no Wakil (guardian one to guard you from the torment).
english_translations.arberry: Do you feel secure that He will not cause the shore to swallow you up, or loose against you a squall of pebbles, then you will find no guardian for you?

ayahs.transliteration: am amintum an yuʿīdakum fīhi tāratan ukh'rā fayur'sila ʿalaykum qāṣifan mina l-rīḥi fayugh'riqakum bimā kafartum thumma lā tajidū lakum ʿalaynā bihi tabīʿan
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা কি ভয়হীন হয়ে গেছ যে, তিনি তোমাদেরকে আরেকবার সমুদ্রে নিয়ে যাবেন না আর তোমাদের উপর প্রচন্ড ঝড়ো হাওয়া পাঠাবেন না আর তোমাদের অকৃতজ্ঞতার কারণে তোমাদেরকে ডুবিয়ে দেবেন না? তখন তোমরা আমার বিরুদ্ধে কোন সাহায্যকারী পাবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into the sea another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.
ayahs.conventional_en: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into the sea another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অথবা তোমরা কি এ বিষয়ে নির্ভয় হয়ে গেছ যে, তিনি তোমাদেরকে দ্বিতীয়বার সেখানে ফিরিয়ে নিয়ে যাবেন না এবং তোমাদের ওপর এক বিধ্বংসী ঝড় প্রেরণ করবেন না, অতঃপর তোমাদের অকৃতজ্ঞতার কারণে তোমাদের ডুবিয়ে দেবেন না? তখন তোমরা আমার বিরুদ্ধে এর কোনো সাহায্যকারী পাবে না!

english_translations.sahih_international: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into the sea another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.
english_translations.pickthall: Or feel ye secure that He will not return you to that (plight) a second time, and send against you a hurricane of wind and drown you for your thanklessness, and then ye will not find therein that ye have any avenger against Us?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Or do ye feel secure that He will not send you back a second time to sea and send against you a heavy gale to drown you because of your ingratitude, so that ye find no helper. Therein against Us?
english_translations.shakir: Or, do you feel secure that He will (not) take you back into it another time, then send on you a fierce gale and thus drown you on account of your ungratefulness? Then you shall not find any aider against Us in the matter.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do you feel secure that We will not drive you back to the sea, send a fierce gale to you, and cause you to drown because of your disbelief when you would not be able to find anyone who would intercede for you with Us?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back a second time to sea and send against you a hurricane of wind and drown you because of your disbelief, then you will not find any avenger therein against Us?
english_translations.arberry: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into it a second time, and loose against you a hurricane of wind and drown you for your thanklessness, then you will find no prosecutor for you against Us?

ayahs.transliteration: walaqad karramnā banī ādama waḥamalnāhum fī l-bari wal-baḥri warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā kathīrin mimman khalaqnā tafḍīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি আদাম সন্তানকে সম্মানিত করেছি, তাদের জন্য জলে স্থলে যানবাহনের ব্যবস্থা করেছি, তাদেরকে পবিত্র রিযক দিয়েছি আর আমি তাদেরকে আমার অধিকাংশ সৃষ্টির উপর মর্যাদায় শ্রেষ্ঠত্ব দান করেছি।
ayahs.translation_en: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি বনি আদমকে সম্মানিত করেছি; তাদেরকে স্থলে ও সমুদ্রে বাহন দিয়েছি; তাদেরকে পবিত্র রিজিক দিয়েছি এবং আমার অনেক সৃষ্টির ওপর তাদেরকে শ্রেষ্ঠত্ব দিয়েছি।

english_translations.sahih_international: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.
english_translations.pickthall: Verily we have honoured the Children of Adam. We carry them on the land and the sea, and have made provision of good things for them, and have preferred them above many of those whom We created with a marked preferment.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: We have honoured the sons of Adam; provided them with transport on land and sea; given them for sustenance things good and pure; and conferred on them special favours, above a great part of our creation.
english_translations.shakir: And surely We have honored the children of Adam, and We carry them in the land and the sea, and We have given them of the good things, and We have made them to excel by an appropriate excellence over most of those whom We have created.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have honored the children of Adam, carried them on the land and the sea, given them pure sustenance and exalted them above most of My creatures.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And indeed We have honoured the Children of Adam, and We have carried them on land and sea, and have provided them with At-Taiyibat (lawful good things), and have preferred them above many of those whom We have created with a marked preference.
english_translations.arberry: We have honoured the Children of Adam and carried them on land and sea, and provided them with good things, and preferred them greatly over many of those We created.

ayahs.transliteration: yawma nadʿū kulla unāsin bi-imāmihim faman ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnihi fa-ulāika yaqraūna kitābahum walā yuẓ'lamūna fatīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: স্মরণ কর, যেদিন আমি সকল সম্প্রদায়কে তাদের নেতাসহ ডাকব, অতঃপর যাদেরকে তাদের ‘আমলনামা ডান হাতে দেয়া হবে, তারা তাদের ‘আমালনামা পাঠ করবে (আনন্দচিত্তে) আর তাদের প্রতি এতটুকু যুলম করা হবে না।
ayahs.translation_en: [Mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
ayahs.conventional_en: [Mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
ayahs.conventional_bn: স্মরণ করো, যেদিন আমি প্রত্যেক দলকে তাদের নেতাসহ আহ্বান করব; অতঃপর যাদের ডান হাতে আমলনামা দেওয়া হবে, তারা নিজেদের আমলনামা পাঠ করবে এবং তাদের প্রতি খেজুরের আঁশের সুতোর পরিমাণও জুলুম করা হবে না।
ayahs.meta_bn: ডেটা-ক্লাস্টার সামন, অরিয়েন্টেশন রাইট ও জিরো-অ্যাসিমেট্রি

english_translations.sahih_international: [Mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
english_translations.pickthall: On the day when We shall summon all men with their record, whoso is given his book in his right hand - such will read their book and they will not be wronged a shred.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: One day We shall call together all human beings with their (respective) Imams: those who are given their record in their right hand will read it (with pleasure), and they will not be dealt with unjustly in the least.
english_translations.shakir: (Remember) the day when We will call every people with their Imam; then whoever is given his book in his right hand, these shall read their book; and they shall not be dealt with a whit unjustly.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when We call every nation with their leaders, those whose record of deeds are given to their right hands will read the book and the least wrong will not be done to them.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (And remember) the Day when We shall call together all human beings with their (respective) Imam [their Prophets, or their records of good and bad deeds, or their Holy Books like the Quran, the Taurat (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel), etc.]. So whosoever is given his record in his right hand, such will read their records, and they will not be dealt with unjustly in the least.
english_translations.arberry: On the day when We shall call all men with their record, and whoso is given his book in his right hand -- those shall read their book, and they shall not be wronged a single date-thread.

ayahs.transliteration: waman kāna fī hādhihi aʿmā fahuwa fī l-ākhirati aʿmā wa-aḍallu sabīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: যে ব্যক্তি এখানে (সত্য পথ দেখার ব্যাপারে) অন্ধ, সে আখেরাতেও হবে অন্ধ, আর সঠিক পথ থেকে অধিক বিচ্যুত।
ayahs.translation_en: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
ayahs.conventional_en: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যে ব্যক্তি এখানে (দুনিয়ায়) অন্ধ ছিল, সে আখিরাতেও অন্ধ এবং অধিকতর পথভ্রষ্ট।

english_translations.sahih_international: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.
english_translations.pickthall: Whoso is blind here will be blind in the Hereafter, and yet further from the road.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But those who were blind in this world, will be blind in the hereafter, and most astray from the Path.
english_translations.shakir: And whoever is blind in this, he shall (also) be blind in the hereafter; and more erring from the way.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Those who are blind in this life will also be blind in the life to come and in terrible error.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And whoever is blind in this world (i.e., does not see Allah's Signs and believes not in Him), will be blind in the Hereafter, and more astray from the Path.
english_translations.arberry: And whosoever is blind in this world shall be blind in the world to come, and he shall be even further astray from the way.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-in kādū layaftinūnaka ʿani alladhī awḥaynā ilayka litaftariya ʿalaynā ghayrahu wa-idhan la-ittakhadhūka khalīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তোমার প্রতি যে ওয়াহী করেছি তাত্থেকে তোমাকে পদস্খলিত করার জন্য তারা চেষ্টার কোন ত্রুটি করেনি যাতে তুমি আমার সম্বন্ধে তার (অর্থাৎ নাযিলকৃত ওয়াহীর) বিপরীতে মিথ্যা রচনা কর, তাহলে তারা তোমাকে অবশ্যই বন্ধু বানিয়ে নিত।
ayahs.translation_en: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
ayahs.conventional_en: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি তোমার প্রতি যা ওহী করেছি তা থেকে তারা তোমাকে পদস্খলিত করার উপক্রম করেছিল—যাতে তুমি আমার নামে অন্য কিছু উদ্ভাবন করো; তবেই তারা তোমাকে বন্ধুরূপে গ্রহণ করত!
ayahs.meta_bn: সিস্টেম টেম্পটেশন, ফেব্রিকেশন প্রেশার ও ফলস অ্যালায়েন্স

english_translations.sahih_international: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
english_translations.pickthall: And they indeed strove hard to beguile thee (Muhammad) away from that wherewith We have inspired thee, that thou shouldst invent other than it against Us; and then would they have accepted thee as a friend.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And their purpose was to tempt thee away from that which We had revealed unto thee, to substitute in our name something quite different; (in that case), behold! they would certainly have made thee (their) friend!
english_translations.shakir: And surely they had purposed to turn you away from that which We have revealed to you, that you should forge against Us other than that, and then they would certainly have taken you for a friend.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Such blind ones) try to confuse what We have revealed to you so that they may falsely ascribe to Us something other than the true revelation and thus establish friendship with you.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, they were about to tempt you away from that which We have revealed (the Quran) unto you (O Muhammad SAW), to fabricate something other than it against Us, and then they would certainly have taken you a friend!
english_translations.arberry: Indeed they were near to seducing thee from that We revealed to thee, that thou mightest forge against Us another, and then they would surely have taken thee as a friend;

ayahs.transliteration: walawlā an thabbatnāka laqad kidtta tarkanu ilayhim shayan qalīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি তোমাকে দৃঢ় প্রতিষ্ঠিত না রাখলে তুমি তাদের দিকে কিছু না কিছু ঝুঁকেই পড়তে।
ayahs.translation_en: And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
ayahs.conventional_en: And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যদি আমি তোমাকে অবিচল না রাখতাম, তবে তুমি তাদের দিকে কিছুটা হলেও ঝুঁকে পড়তে!

english_translations.shakir: In that case We would certainly have made you to taste a double (punishment) in this life and a double (punishment) after death, then you would not have found any helper against Us.

english_translations.pickthall: (Such was Our) method in the case of those whom We sent before thee (to mankind), and thou wilt not find for Our method aught of power to change.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (This was Our) way with the messengers We sent before thee: thou wilt find no change in Our ways.
english_translations.shakir: (This is Our) course with regard to those of Our apostles whom We sent before you, and you shall not find a change in Our course.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: This was Our tradition with Our Messengers who lived before you, and you will find no change in Our tradition.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: (This was Our) Sunnah (rule or way) with the Messengers We sent before you (O Muhammad SAW), and you will not find any alteration in Our Sunnah (rule or way, etc.).
english_translations.arberry: the wont of those We sent before thee of Our Messengers; thou wilt find no change to Our wont.

english_translations.sahih_international: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur'an of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
english_translations.pickthall: Establish worship at the going down of the sun until the dark of night, and (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn. Lo! (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Establish regular prayers - at the sun's decline till the darkness of the night, and the morning prayer and reading: for the prayer and reading in the morning carry their testimony.
english_translations.shakir: Keep up prayer from the declining of the sun till the darkness of the night and the morning recitation; surely the morning recitation is witnessed.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Say your prayer when the sun declines until the darkness of night and also at dawn. Dawn is certainly witnessed (by the angels of the night and day).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat) from mid-day till the darkness of the night (i.e. the Zuhr, 'Asr, Maghrib, and 'Isha' prayers), and recite the Quran in the early dawn (i.e. the morning prayer). Verily, the recitation of the Quran in the early dawn is ever witnessed (attended by the angels in charge of mankind of the day and the night).
english_translations.arberry: Perform the prayer at the sinking of the sun to the darkening of the night and the recital of dawn; surely the recital of dawn is witnessed.

ayahs.transliteration: wamina al-layli fatahajjad bihi nāfilatan laka ʿasā an yabʿathaka rabbuka maqāman maḥmūdan
ayahs.translation_bn: আর রাত্রির কিছু অংশে তাহাজ্জুদ পড়, ওটা তোমার জন্য নফল, শীঘ্রই তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমাকে প্রশংসিত স্থানে উন্নীত করবেন।
ayahs.translation_en: And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
ayahs.conventional_en: And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর রাতের কিছু অংশে তাহাজ্জুদ আদায় করো—যা তোমার জন্য এক অতিরিক্ত ইবাদত; আশা করা যায় তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমাকে ‘মাকামে মাহমুদ’ (প্রশংসিত স্থান)-এ উন্নীত করবেন।
ayahs.meta_bn: নক্টার্নাল অতিরিক্ত সিঙ্ক্রোনাইজেশন ও মাকামে মাহমুদ
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ — তাহাজ্জুদ বা ডেটা-অতিরিক্ত সিঙ্ক্রোনাইজেশন প্রটোকল; نَافِلَةً — ডেটা-অতিরিক্ত / নফল বা অতিরিক্ত সুযোগ; مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا — ডেটা-প্রশংসিত মর্যাদা / সুমহান মাকামে মাহমুদ।

metadata.theme: নক্টার্নাল অতিরিক্ত সিঙ্ক্রোনাইজেশন ও মাকামে মাহমুদ
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ — তাহাজ্জুদ বা ডেটা-অতিরিক্ত সিঙ্ক্রোনাইজেশন প্রটোকল; نَافِلَةً — ডেটা-অতিরিক্ত / নফল বা অতিরিক্ত সুযোগ; مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا — ডেটা-প্রশংসিত মর্যাদা / সুমহান মাকামে মাহমুদ।
metadata.theme_bn: রাতের তাহাজ্জুদ সালাত ও মাকামে মাহমুদ (প্রশংসিত সর্বোচ্চ মর্যাদা) অর্জনের সুসংবাদ
metadata.underlying_meaning_bn: রাত্রির একাংশে গভীর জাগরণ ও তাহাজ্জুদ: ওহীর সাথে ব্যক্তিগত চেতনার সিস্টেম সিঙ্ক্রোনাইজেশন ও নিউরাল রিসেট, যেন তোমার প্রতিপালক তোমাকে সর্বোচ্চ কার্যকর প্রশংসিত মর্যাদায় (মাক্বামাম মাহমুদা) উন্নীত করেন।

english_translations.sahih_international: And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
english_translations.pickthall: And some part of the night awake for it, a largess for thee. It may be that thy Lord will raise thee to a praised estate.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And pray in the small watches of the morning: (it would be) an additional prayer (or spiritual profit) for thee: soon will thy Lord raise thee to a Station of Praise and Glory!
english_translations.shakir: And during a part of the night, pray Tahajjud beyond what is incumbent on you; maybe your Lord will raise you to a position of great glory.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Say your special (tahajjud) prayer during some part of the night as an additional (obligatory) prayer for you alone so that perhaps your Lord will raise you to a highly praiseworthy position.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And in some parts of the night (also) offer the Salat (prayer) with it (i.e. recite the Quran in the prayer), as an additional prayer (Tahajjud optional prayer Nawafil) for you (O Muhammad SAW). It may be that your Lord will raise you to Maqaman Mahmuda (a station of praise and glory, i.e. the highest degree in Paradise!).
english_translations.arberry: And as for the night, keep vigil a part of it, as a work of supererogation for thee; it may be that thy Lord will raise thee up to a laudable station.

ayahs.transliteration: waqul rabbi adkhil'nī mud'khala ṣid'qin wa-akhrij'nī mukh'raja ṣid'qin wa-ij'ʿal lī min ladunka sul'ṭānan naṣīran
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘হে আমার প্রতিপালক! আমাকে (যেখানেই) প্রবেশ করাও, (সেটা কর) সত্য ও সম্মানের প্রবেশ, আর আমাকে (যেখান হতেই) বের কর, (সেটা কর) সত্য ও সম্মানের বহির্গমন, আর তোমার নিকট হতে আমাকে এক সাহায্যকারী শক্তি দান কর।
ayahs.translation_en: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
ayahs.conventional_en: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর বলো—‘হে আমার রব! আমাকে সত্যের প্রবেশে প্রবেশ করাও এবং সত্যের বেরোনোতে বের করো; আর তোমার পক্ষ থেকে আমাকে সাহায্যকারী শক্তি দাও’।
ayahs.meta_bn: ট্রুথ-বেসড এন্ট্রি-এক্সিট ও অথরাইজড ভিক্টরি
ayahs.meta_en: Truth Protocol Entry/Exit & Victorious Authority Allocation
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ — ডেটা-ট্রুথ প্রটোকল সহ ডেটা-এন্ট্রি / সত্যনিষ্ঠ প্রবেশ; مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ — ডেটা-ট্রুথ প্রটোকল সহ ডেটা-এক্সিট / সত্যনিষ্ঠ প্রস্থান; سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا — ডেটা-পারমিশন ও ডেটা-সাপোর্ট / বিজয়ী সাহায্যকারী পরাক্রম।

metadata.theme: ট্রুথ-বেসড এন্ট্রি-এক্সিট ও অথরাইজড ভিক্টরি

english_translations.sahih_international: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
english_translations.pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "O my Lord! Let my entry be by the Gate of Truth and Honour, and likewise my exit by the Gate of Truth and Honour; and grant me from Thy Presence an authority to aid (me)."
english_translations.shakir: And say: My Lord! make me to enter a goodly entering, and cause me to go forth a goodly going forth, and grant me from near Thee power to assist (me).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "Lord, make me enter through a path that will lead to the Truth and come out of an exit that will take me to the Truth. Give me helpful authority.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And say (O Muhammad SAW): My Lord! Let my entry (to the city of Al-Madinah) be good, and likewise my exit (from the city of Makkah) be good. And grant me from You an authority to help me (or a firm sign or a proof).
english_translations.arberry: And say: 'My Lord, lead me in with a just ingoing, and lead me out with a just outgoing; grant me authority from Thee, to help me.'

ayahs.transliteration: waqul jāa l-ḥaqu wazahaqa l-bāṭilu inna l-bāṭila kāna zahūqan
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘সত্য এসে গেছে আর মিথ্যা বিলুপ্ত হয়েছে, মিথ্যা তো বিলুপ্ত হওয়ারই।’
ayahs.translation_en: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
ayahs.conventional_en: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর বলো, ‘সত্য এসেছে এবং মিথ্যা বিলুপ্ত হয়েছে; নিশ্চয়ই মিথ্যা বিলুপ্ত হওয়ারই বিষয়’।
ayahs.meta_bn: ডেটা-ট্রুথের আগমন ও নাল সিগন্যালের ডিকমিশনিং
ayahs.meta_en: Arrival of Data-Truth & Decommissioning of Null Signals
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: الْحَقُّ — ডেটা-ট্রুথ / পরম সত্য ও বাস্তব সত্যতা; زَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ — শূন্য বা ভ্রান্ত সিগন্যাল ডেটা-ডিকমিশন / বিলুপ্ত হওয়া; زَهُوقًا — স্বভাবগতভাবেই বিলোপযোগ্য ও ক্ষণস্থায়ী।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: الْحَقُّ — ডেটা-ট্রুথ / পরম সত্য ও বাস্তব সত্যতা; زَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ — শূন্য বা ভ্রান্ত সিগন্যাল ডেটা-ডিকমিশন / বিলুপ্ত হওয়া; زَهُوقًا — স্বভাবগতভাবেই বিলোপযোগ্য ও ক্ষণস্থায়ী।

english_translations.sahih_international: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
english_translations.pickthall: And say: Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away. Lo! falsehood is ever bound to vanish.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And say: "Truth has (now) arrived, and Falsehood perished: for Falsehood is (by its nature) bound to perish."
english_translations.shakir: And say: The truth has come and the falsehood has vanished; surely falsehood is a vanishing (thing).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Say, 'Truth has come and falsehood has been banished; it is doomed to banishment.'"
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And say: "Truth (i.e. Islamic Monotheism or this Quran or Jihad against polytheists) has come and Batil (falsehood, i.e. Satan or polytheism, etc.) has vanished. Surely! Batil is ever bound to vanish."
english_translations.arberry: And say: 'The truth has come, and falsehood has vanished away; surely falsehood is ever certain to vanish.'

ayahs.transliteration: wanunazzilu mina l-qur'āni mā huwa shifāon waraḥmatun lil'mu'minīna walā yazīdu l-ẓālimīna illā khasāran
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি কুরআন হতে (ক্রমশঃ) অবতীর্ণ করি যা মু’মিনদের জন্য আরোগ্য ও রহমাত, কিন্তু তা যালিমদের ক্ষতিই বৃদ্ধি করে।
ayahs.translation_en: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি কুরআনে এমন কিছু নাযিল করি যা মুমিনদের জন্য আরোগ্য ও রহমত; কিন্তু তা জালেমদের কেবল ক্ষতিই বৃদ্ধি করে।
ayahs.meta_bn: ডেটা-হিলিং প্রটোকল, কম্প্যাশন ও অ্যাসিমেট্রি ক্রিয়েটর লস

english_translations.sahih_international: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
english_translations.pickthall: And We reveal of the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy for believers though it increase the evil-doers in naught save ruin.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: We send down (stage by stage) in the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy to those who believe: to the unjust it causes nothing but loss after loss.
english_translations.shakir: And We reveal of the Quran that which is a healing and a mercy to the believers, and it adds only to the perdition of the unjust.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We reveal the Quran which is a cure and mercy for the believers but does nothing for the unjust except to lead them to perdition.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And We send down from the Quran that which is a healing and a mercy to those who believe (in Islamic Monotheism and act on it), and it increases the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers) nothing but loss.
english_translations.arberry: And We send down, of the Koran, that which is a healing and a mercy to the believers; and the unbelievers it increases not, except in loss.

ayahs.transliteration: wa-idhā anʿamnā ʿalā l-insāni aʿraḍa wanaā bijānibihi wa-idhā massahu l-sharu kāna yaūsan
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি যখন মানুষের প্রতি অনুগ্রহ বর্ষণ করি তখন সে মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয়, আর অহঙ্কারে দূরে সরে পড়ে; কিন্তু যখন অমঙ্গল তাকে স্পর্শ করে তখন সে নিরাশ হয়ে যায়।
ayahs.translation_en: And when We bestow favor upon the disbeliever, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
ayahs.conventional_en: And when We bestow favor upon the disbeliever, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর যখন আমি মানুষের প্রতি অনুগ্রহ করি, তখন সে মুখ ফিরিয়ে নেয় এবং অহংকারে দূরে সরে যায়; আর যখন তাকে কোনো অনিষ্ট স্পর্শ করে, তখন সে সম্পূর্ণ হতাশ হয়ে পড়ে।
ayahs.meta_bn: ব্লেসিংয়ে ডিসকানেকশন ও স্ট্রেসে ডেস্পন্ডেন্সি
ayahs.meta_en: Disconnection in Prosperity & Despondency in Stress

english_translations.sahih_international: And when We bestow favor upon the disbeliever, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
english_translations.pickthall: And when We make life pleasant unto man, he turneth away and is averse; and when ill toucheth him he is in despair.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Yet when We bestow Our favours on man, he turns away and becomes remote on his side (instead of coming to Us), and when evil seizes him he gives himself up to despair!
english_translations.shakir: And when We bestow favor on man, he turns aside and behaves proudly, and when evil afflicts him, he is despairing.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: When We do favors to the human being, he disregards it and turns away from it. When evil afflicts him, he becomes despairing.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And when We bestow Our Grace on man (the disbeliever), he turns away and becomes arrogant, far away from the Right Path. And when evil touches him he is in great despair.
english_translations.arberry: And when We bless man, he turns away, and withdraws aside; but when evil visits him, he is in despair.

ayahs.transliteration: qul kullun yaʿmalu ʿalā shākilatihi farabbukum aʿlamu biman huwa ahdā sabīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘প্রত্যেকেই স্বীয় রীতি-পন্থা অনুযায়ী কাজ করে। এখন তোমার রববই ভাল জানেন কে চলার পথে অধিকতর সঠিক পথে আছে।
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো, ‘প্রত্যেকেই নিজ নিজ পদ্ধতি অনুযায়ী কাজ করে; অতঃপর তোমাদের প্রতিপালকই সবচেয়ে ভালো জানেন কে অধিকতর সঠিক পথে রয়েছে’।
ayahs.meta_bn: নিজস্ব অ্যালগরিদমে এক্সিকিউশন ও অপটিমাইজড পাথওয়ে
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ — নিজস্ব ডেটা-অ্যালগরিদম বা মননকাঠামো অনুযায়ী; أَعْلَمُ — সম্যক জ্ঞানসম্পন্ন বা পূর্ণ ডেটা-অ্যাওয়ারনেসযুক্ত; أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا — সর্বাধিক সুপথপ্রাপ্ত বা ডেটা-অপটিমাইজড পাথওয়ে।

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
english_translations.pickthall: Say: Each one doth according to his rule of conduct, and thy Lord is Best Aware of him whose way is right.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "Everyone acts according to his own disposition: But your Lord knows best who it is that is best guided on the Way."
english_translations.shakir: Say: Every one acts according to his manner; but your Lord best knows who is best guided in the path.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "Everyone does as he wants. Your Lord knows best who has the right guidance."
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW to mankind): "Each one does according to Shakilatihi (i.e. his way or his religion or his intentions, etc.), and your Lord knows best of him whose path (religion, etc.) is right."
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'Every man works according to his own manner; but your Lord knows very well what man is best guided as to the way.'

ayahs.transliteration: wayasalūnaka ʿani l-rūḥi quli l-rūḥu min amri rabbī wamā ūtītum mina l-ʿil'mi illā qalīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমাকে তারা রূহ সম্পর্কে জিজ্ঞেস করে। বল, ‘রূহ হচ্ছে আমার প্রতিপালকের হুকুমের অন্তর্ভুক্ত (একটি হুকুম)। এ সম্পর্কে তোমাকে অতি সামান্য জ্ঞানই দেয়া হয়েছে।’
ayahs.translation_en: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little."
ayahs.conventional_en: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তারা তোমাকে ‘রূহ’ সম্পর্কে জিজ্ঞেস করে; বলো, ‘রূহ হলো আমার প্রতিপালকের আদেশঘটিত বিষয়; আর তোমাদেরকে অতি সামান্য জ্ঞানই দেওয়া হয়েছে’।

english_translations.sahih_international: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair of my Lord. And mankind have not been given of knowledge except a little."
english_translations.pickthall: They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord, and of knowledge ye have been vouchsafed but little.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: They ask thee concerning the Spirit (of inspiration). Say: "The Spirit (cometh) by command of my Lord: of knowledge it is only a little that is communicated to you, (O men!)"
english_translations.shakir: And they ask you about the soul. Say: The soul is one of the commands of my Lord, and you are not given aught of knowledge but a little.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They ask you about the Spirit. Say, "The Spirit comes by the command of my Lord. You have been given very little knowledge.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And they ask you (O Muhammad SAW) concerning the Ruh (the Spirit); Say: "The Ruh (the Spirit): it is one of the things, the knowledge of which is only with my Lord. And of knowledge, you (mankind) have been given only a little."
english_translations.arberry: They will question thee concerning the Spirit. Say: 'The Spirit is of the bidding of my Lord. You have been given of knowledge nothing except a little.'

ayahs.transliteration: wala-in shi'nā lanadhhabanna bi-alladhī awḥaynā ilayka thumma lā tajidu laka bihi ʿalaynā wakīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: ইচ্ছে করলে আমি তোমার প্রতি যা ওয়াহী করেছি তা কেড়ে নিতে পারতাম, সে অবস্থায় তুমি আমার বিরুদ্ধে তোমার জন্য কোন কার্য সম্পাদনকারী পাবে না
ayahs.translation_en: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
ayahs.conventional_en: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি ইচ্ছা করলে তোমার প্রতি যা ওহী করেছি তা অবশ্যই প্রত্যাহার করে নিতে পারি; অতঃপর তুমি এ বিষয়ে আমার বিরুদ্ধে কোনো কর্মবিধায়ক পাবে না।
ayahs.meta_bn: রেভেলেশন ডেটা-রিটেনশন ও প্রিফারেনশিয়াল রিমুভাল
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: لَنَذْهَبَنَّ — ডেটা-রিমুভ করা / সম্পূর্ণ প্রত্যাহার করে নেওয়া; أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ — তোমার নিকট ওহী/ডেটা-প্যাকেট প্রেরণ; وَكِيلًا — ডেটা-এজেন্ট বা প্রতিবিধানকারী অভিভাবক।

english_translations.sahih_international: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
english_translations.pickthall: And if We willed We could withdraw that which We have revealed unto thee, then wouldst thou find no guardian for thee against Us in respect thereof.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: If it were Our Will, We could take away that which We have sent thee by inspiration: then wouldst thou find none to plead thy affair in that matter as against Us,-
english_translations.shakir: And if We please, We should certainly take away that which We have revealed to you, then you would not find for it any protector against Us.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Had We wanted, We could have removed the Spirit through whom We sent you revelation. Then you would not have found anyone to intercede with Us for you
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And if We willed We could surely take away that which We have revealed to you by inspiration (i.e. this Quran). Then you would find no protector for you against Us in that respect.
english_translations.arberry: If We willed, We could take away that We have revealed to thee, then thou wouldst find none thereover to guard thee against Us,

ayahs.transliteration: illā raḥmatan min rabbika inna faḍlahu kāna ʿalayka kabīran
ayahs.translation_bn: তোমার প্রতিপালকের দয়া ছাড়া। তোমার প্রতি তাঁর অনুগ্রহ (সত্যিই) বিরাট।
ayahs.translation_en: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
ayahs.conventional_en: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
ayahs.conventional_bn: কিন্তু তোমার প্রতিপালকের অনুগ্রহস্বরূপ (তা প্রত্যাহার করা হয়নি); নিশ্চয়ই তোমার প্রতি তাঁর অনুগ্রহ অপরিসীম।

english_translations.sahih_international: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.
english_translations.pickthall: (It is naught) save mercy from thy Lord. Lo! His kindness unto thee was ever great.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Except for Mercy from thy Lord: for his bounty is to thee (indeed) great.
english_translations.shakir: But on account of mercy from your Lord-- surely His grace to you is abundant.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: except by the mercy of your Lord. He has certainly bestowed great favors on you.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Except as a Mercy from your Lord. Verily! His Grace unto you (O Muhammad SAW) is ever great.
english_translations.arberry: excepting by some mercy of thy Lord; surly His favour to thee is great.

ayahs.transliteration: qul la-ini ij'tamaʿati l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā an yatū bimith'li hādhā l-qur'āni lā yatūna bimith'lihi walaw kāna baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ẓahīran
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘এ কুরআনের মত একখানা কুরআন আনার জন্য যদি সমগ্র মানব আর জ্বীন একত্রিত হয় তবুও তারা তার মত আনতে পারবে না, যদিও তারা পরস্পর পরস্পরকে সাহায্য ও সহযোগিতা করে।’
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো, ‘যদি মানবজাতি ও জ্বিনজাতি এই কুরআনের মতো কিছু তৈরি করতে একত্র হয়, তবুও তারা এর অনুরূপ আনতে পারবে না—যদিও তারা একে অপরের সাহায্যকারী হয়’!
ayahs.meta_bn: ম্যানুয়াল আনপ্যারালালডনেস ও ইনএবিলিটি টু রেজেনারেট
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: الإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ — ফ্রি-উইল নোডস ও ডেটা-এনার্জি নোডস (মানুষ ও জ্বিন); بِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ — এই কুরআনের সমতুল্য ডেটা উৎপাদন; ظَهِيرًا — ডেটা-সাপোর্ট নোড / সহযোগী ও পৃষ্ঠপোষক।

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."
english_translations.pickthall: Say: Verily, though mankind and the jinn should assemble to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof though they were helpers one of another.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "If the whole of mankind and Jinns were to gather together to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof, even if they backed up each other with help and support.
english_translations.shakir: Say: If men and jinn should combine together to bring the like of this Quran, they could not bring the like of it, though some of them were aiders of others.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "If all human beings and jinn were to come together to bring the equivalent of this Quran, they could not do so, even if they all were to help each other.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say: "If the mankind and the jinns were together to produce the like of this Quran, they could not produce the like thereof, even if they helped one another."
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'If men and jinn banded together to produce the like of this Koran, they would never produce its like, not though they backed one another.'

ayahs.transliteration: walaqad ṣarrafnā lilnnāsi fī hādhā l-qur'āni min kulli mathalin fa-abā aktharu l-nāsi illā kufūran
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি এ কুরআনে মানুষের জন্য যাবতীয় দৃষ্টান্ত বিস্তারিতভাবে বর্ণনা করেছি, কিন্তু অধিকাংশ মানুষই ঈমান গ্রহণ করতে অস্বীকার করে কেবল কুফরিই করল।
ayahs.translation_en: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind] of example, but most of the people refused [anything] except disbelief.
ayahs.conventional_en: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind] of example, but most of the people refused [anything] except disbelief.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি অবশ্যই এই কুরআনে মানুষের জন্য প্রত্যেকটি বিষয়ের উপমা বিস্তারিত বর্ণনা করেছি; কিন্তু অধিকাংশ মানুষ কেবল অকৃতজ্ঞতা ও অস্বীকারই বেছে নিয়েছে।
ayahs.meta_bn: মাল্টি-ফেসেটেড অ্যানালজি ও নোড অস্বীকৃতি
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: صَرَّفْنَا — বহুমুখী ডেটা-অ্যানালজি বা উদাহরণ দ্বারা বিশদ বিশ্লেষণ; كُلِّ مَثَلٍ — সর্বপ্রকার দৃষ্টান্ত; كَفُورًا — ডেটা-ডিনাই বা একগুঁয়ে অকৃতজ্ঞতা।

english_translations.sahih_international: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind] of example, but most of the people refused [anything] except disbelief.
english_translations.pickthall: And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all kind of similitudes, but most of mankind refuse aught save disbelief.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And We have explained to man, in this Qur'an, every kind of similitude: yet the greater part of men refuse (to receive it) except with ingratitude!
english_translations.shakir: And certainly We have explained for men in this Quran every kind of similitude, but most men do not consent to aught but denying.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have mentioned in this Quran all kinds of examples for the human being, but most human beings turn away in disbelief.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And indeed We have fully explained to mankind, in this Quran, every kind of similitude, but most mankind refuse (the truth and accept nothing) but disbelief.
english_translations.arberry: We have indeed turned about for men in this Koran every manner of similitude; yet most men refuse all but unbelief.

ayahs.transliteration: waqālū lan nu'mina laka ḥattā tafjura lanā mina l-arḍi yanbūʿan
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা বলে, ‘আমরা তোমার প্রতি কক্ষনো ঈমান আনব না যে পর্যন্ত তুমি আমাদের জন্য যমীন থেকে ঝর্ণাধারা প্রবাহিত না করবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring.
ayahs.conventional_en: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তারা বলে, ‘আমরা কখনই তোমার প্রতি ঈমান আনব না—যতক্ষণ না তুমি আমাদের জন্য যমীন থেকে একটি ঝরনা প্রবাহিত করো’!
ayahs.meta_bn: ফলস ডিমান্ডস: ফ্রেশওয়াটার স্প্রিং রিকোয়ারমেন্ট

english_translations.pickthall: And they say: We will not put faith in thee till thou cause a spring to gush forth from the earth for us;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: They say: "We shall not believe in thee, until thou cause a spring to gush forth for us from the earth,
english_translations.shakir: And they say: We will by no means believe in you until you cause a fountain to gush forth from the earth for us.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: They have said, "We shall never believe you until you cause a spring to gush forth from the earth,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And they say: "We shall not believe in you (O Muhammad SAW), until you cause a spring to gush forth from the earth for us;
english_translations.arberry: They say, 'We will not believe thee till thou makest a spring to gush forth from the earth for us,

ayahs.transliteration: aw takūna laka jannatun min nakhīlin waʿinabin fatufajjira l-anhāra khilālahā tafjīran
ayahs.translation_bn: কিংবা (যতক্ষণ না) তোমার খেজুর ও আঙ্গুরের বাগান হবে যার ফাঁকে ফাঁকে তুমি ঝর্ণা প্রবাহিত করবে অজস্র ধারায়।

words.translation_en: and you cause to gush forth

ayahs.translation_en: Or [until] you have a garden of palm tress and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
ayahs.conventional_en: Or [until] you have a garden of palm tress and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
ayahs.conventional_bn: ‘অথবা তোমার জন্য খেজুর ও আঙ্গুরের কোনো বাগান হবে, অতঃপর তুমি তার মধ্য দিয়ে নদীসমূহকে ব্যাপকভাবে প্রবাহিত করে দেবে’!
ayahs.meta_bn: ফলস ডিমান্ডস: লাক্সারি এগ্রিকালচারাল ইকোসিস্টেম
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: نَّخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ — ডেটা-শর্করা ও অ্যান্টি-অক্সিডেন্ট সোর্স (খেজুর ও আঙুর); الْأَنْهَارَ — ডেটা-ফ্রেশওয়াটার স্ট্রিম / নদ-নদীসমূহ; تَفْجِيرًا — প্রবল বেগে প্রবাহিত করা।

english_translations.sahih_international: Or [until] you have a garden of palm tress and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
english_translations.pickthall: Or thou have a garden of date-palms and grapes, and cause rivers to gush forth therein abundantly;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "Or (until) thou have a garden of date trees and vines, and cause rivers to gush forth in their midst, carrying abundant water;
english_translations.shakir: Or you should have a garden of palms and grapes in the midst of which you should cause rivers to flow forth, gushing out.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: or you (show) us that you have your own garden of palm trees and vines with flowing streams therein,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "Or you have a garden of date-palms and grapes, and cause rivers to gush forth in their midst abundantly;
english_translations.arberry: or till thou possessest a garden of plants and vines, and thou makest rivers to gush forth abundantly all amongst it,

ayahs.transliteration: aw tus'qiṭa l-samāa kamā zaʿamta ʿalaynā kisafan aw tatiya bil-lahi wal-malāikati qabīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: অথবা (যতক্ষণ না) তুমি আকাশকে টুকরো টুকরো করে আমাদের উপর ফেলবে যেমন তুমি বলে থাক (যে তা ঘটবে) কিংবা আল্লাহ আর ফেরেশতাগণকে সরাসরি আমাদের সামনে এনে দেবে।
ayahs.translation_en: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allah and the angels before [us]
ayahs.conventional_en: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allah and the angels before [us]
ayahs.conventional_bn: ‘অথবা তুমি যেমন দাবি করো, সে অনুযায়ী আকাশকে আমাদের ওপর খণ্ড-বিখণ্ড করে ফেলবে, কিংবা আল্লাহ ও ফেরেশতাদের আমাদের সামনে উপস্থিত করবে’!
ayahs.meta_bn: ফলস ডিমান্ডস: কসমিক ফ্র্যাগমেন্টেশন ও ফেস-টু-ফেস ভেরিফিকেশন

english_translations.sahih_international: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allah and the angels before [us]
english_translations.pickthall: Or thou cause the heaven to fall upon us piecemeal, as thou hast pretended, or bring Allah and the angels as a warrant;
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "Or thou cause the sky to fall in pieces, as thou sayest (will happen), against us; or thou bring Allah and the angels before (us) face to face:
english_translations.shakir: Or you should cause the heaven to come down upon us in pieces as you think, or bring Allah and the angels face to face (with us).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: or cause the sky to fall into pieces on us - as you believe you can - or bring God and the angels face to face with us,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "Or you cause the heaven to fall upon us in pieces, as you have pretended, or you bring Allah and the angels before (us) face to face;
english_translations.arberry: or till thou makest heaven to fall, as thou assertest, on us in fragments, or thou bringest God and the angels as a surety,

ayahs.transliteration: aw yakūna laka baytun min zukh'rufin aw tarqā fī l-samāi walan nu'mina liruqiyyika ḥattā tunazzila ʿalaynā kitāban naqra-uhu qul sub'ḥāna rabbī hal kuntu illā basharan rasūlan
ayahs.translation_bn: কিংবা (যতক্ষণ না) তোমার একটা স্বর্ণখচিত গৃহ হবে কিংবা তুমি আসমানে আরোহণ করবে। আর তোমার এ আরোহণকেও আমরা কক্ষনো বিশ্বাস করব না যতক্ষণ না তুমি আমাদের প্রতি এক কিতাব অবতীর্ণ করবে যা আমরা পাঠ করব।’ বল, ‘আমি আমার প্রতিপালকের মহিমা ও পবিত্রতা ঘোষণা করছি, আমি একজন মানুষ রসূল ছাড়া কি অন্য কিছু?
ayahs.translation_en: Or you have a house of gold or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
ayahs.conventional_en: Or you have a house of gold or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
ayahs.conventional_bn: ‘কিংবা তোমার একটি সোনার তৈরি ঘর থাকবে, অথবা তুমি আকাশে আরোহণ করবে; আর তোমার আরোহণকেও আমরা কখনই বিশ্বাস করব না—যতক্ষণ না তুমি আমাদের ওপর একটি কিতাব নাযিল করো যা আমরা পাঠ করব’। বলো, ‘আমার প্রতিপালক পরম পবিত্র! আমি তো একজন মানুষ ছাড়া আর কিছু নই—যাকে রাসূল করে পাঠানো হয়েছে’!
ayahs.meta_bn: অর্বিটাল ক্লাইম্ব ডিমান্ড ও ট্রান্সমিটার বাউন্ডারি
ayahs.meta_en: Demands for Celestial Ascendance & Mortal Messenger Boundaries
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: بَيْتٌ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ — ডেটা-প্রিমিয়াম জোন বা স্বর্ণখচিত প্রাসাদ; تَرْقَىٰ فِي السَّمَاءِ — মহাজাগতিক স্তরে আরোহণ; بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا — একজন মানব নোড ও বার্তাবাহক।

english_translations.sahih_international: Or you have a house of gold or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"
english_translations.pickthall: Or thou have a house of gold; or thou ascend up into heaven, and even then we will put no faith in thine ascension till thou bring down for us a book that we can read. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord be Glorified! Am I aught save a mortal messenger?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: "Or thou have a house adorned with gold, or thou mount a ladder right into the skies. No, we shall not even believe in thy mounting until thou send down to us a book that we could read." Say: "Glory to my Lord! Am I aught but a man,- a messenger?"
english_translations.shakir: Or you should have a house of gold, or you should ascend into heaven, and we will not believe in your ascending until you bring down to us a book which we may read. Say: Glory be to my Lord; am I aught but a mortal apostle?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: or (show us) that you have a well adorned house of your own, or climb into the sky. We shall never believe that you have climbed into the sky until you bring us a book that we can read." Say, "All glory belongs to my Lord. Am I more than a mortal Messenger?"
english_translations.mohsin_khan: "Or you have a house of adornable materials (like silver and pure gold, etc.), or you ascend up into the sky, and even then we will put no faith in your ascension until you bring down for us a Book that we would read." Say (O Muhammad SAW): "Glorified (and Exalted) be my Lord (Allah) above all that evil they (polytheists) associate with Him! Am I anything but a man, sent as a Messenger?"
english_translations.arberry: or till thou possessest a house of gold ornament, or till thou goest up into heaven; and we will not believe thy going up till thou bringest down on us a book that we may read. Say: 'Glory be to my Lord. Am I aught but a mortal, a Messenger?'

ayahs.transliteration: wamā manaʿa l-nāsa an yu'minū idh jāahumu l-hudā illā an qālū abaʿatha l-lahu basharan rasūlan
ayahs.translation_bn: মানুষের কাছে যখন পথের নির্দেশ আসে তখন তাদেরকে ঈমান আনতে তাদের এ কথা ছাড়া অন্য কিছুই বিরত রাখে না যে, ‘আল্লাহ কি মানুষকে রসূল বানিয়ে পাঠিয়েছেন?’
ayahs.translation_en: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allah sent a human messenger?"
ayahs.conventional_en: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allah sent a human messenger?"
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর মানুষের কাছে যখন হিদায়াত আসে, তখন তাদেরকে ঈমান আনা থেকে কেবল তাদের এই কথাই বিরত রাখে যে, তারা বলে—‘আল্লাহ কি কোনো মানুষকে রাসূল করে পাঠিয়েছেন’?
ayahs.meta_bn: হিউম্যান ট্রান্সমিটারে সংশয় ও ভেরিফিকেশন ব্যারিয়ার
ayahs.meta_en: Cognitive Barrier to Mortal Human Messengers

english_translations.sahih_international: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allah sent a human messenger?"
english_translations.pickthall: And naught prevented mankind from believing when the guidance came unto them save that they said: Hath Allah sent a mortal as (His) messenger?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: What kept men back from belief when Guidance came to them, was nothing but this: they said, "Has Allah sent a man (like us) to be (His) Messenger?"
english_translations.shakir: And nothing prevented people from believing when the guidance came to them except that they said: What! has Allah raised up a mortal to be an apostle?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: What keeps people from belief that guidance has come to them, but they question, "Why has God sent a mortal Messenger?"
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And nothing prevented men from believing when the guidance came to them, except that they said: "Has Allah sent a man as (His) Messenger?"
english_translations.arberry: And naught prevented men from believing when the guidance came to them, but that they said, 'Has God sent forth a mortal as Messenger?'

ayahs.transliteration: qul law kāna fī l-arḍi malāikatun yamshūna muṭ'ma-innīna lanazzalnā ʿalayhim mina l-samāi malakan rasūlan
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘দুনিয়াতে যদি ফেরেশতাগণের বসবাস হত যারা নিশ্চিন্তে নিরাপদে চলাফেরা করত, তাহলে অবশ্যই আমি তাদের কাছে ফেরেশতা রসূল পাঠাতাম।’
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো, ‘যদি যমীনে ফেরেশতারা শান্তভাবে বিচরণ করত, তবে অবশ্যই আমি আকাশ থেকে তাদের কাছে কোনো ফেরেশতাকেই রাসূল করে পাঠাতাম’।
ayahs.meta_bn: হোমোলোগাস ট্রান্সমিশন লজিক: এঞ্জেলিক ভার্সাস হিউম্যান নোডস

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."
english_translations.pickthall: Say: If there were in the earth angels walking secure, We had sent down for them from heaven an angel as messenger.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say, "If there were settled, on earth, angels walking about in peace and quiet, We should certainly have sent them down from the heavens an angel for a messenger."
english_translations.shakir: Say: Had there been in the earth angels walking about as settlers, We would certainly have sent down to them from the heaven an angel as an apostle.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "Had the earth been inhabited by angels who would walk serenely therein, only then would We have sent to them angelic Messengers".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say: "If there were on the earth, angels walking about in peace and security, We should certainly have sent down for them from the heaven an angel as a Messenger."
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'Had there been in the earth angels walking. at peace, We would have sent down upon them out of heaven an angel as Messenger.'

ayahs.transliteration: qul kafā bil-lahi shahīdan baynī wabaynakum innahu kāna biʿibādihi khabīran baṣīran
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘আমার ও তোমাদের মাঝে আল্লাহর সাক্ষ্যই যথেষ্ট, তিনি তাঁর বান্দাদের সম্পর্কে পুরোপুরি ওয়াকিফহাল, আর তিনি সর্বদ্রষ্টা।’
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. Indeed he is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing."
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. Indeed he is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing."
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো, ‘আমার ও তোমাদের মধ্যে সাক্ষী হিসেবে আল্লাহই যথেষ্ট; নিশ্চয়ই তিনি তাঁর বান্দাদের বিষয়ে সম্যক অবগত, প্রত্যক্ষকারী’।
ayahs.meta_bn: সুপ্রিম অডিট নোড ও অল-ভিশন মনিটরিং

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. Indeed he is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing."
english_translations.pickthall: Say: Allah sufficeth for a witness between me and you. Lo! He is Knower, Seer of His slaves.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "Enough is Allah for a witness between me and you: for He is well acquainted with His servants, and He sees (all things).
english_translations.shakir: Say: Allah suffices as a witness between me and you; surely He is Aware of His servants, Seeing.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "God is a sufficient Witness between me and you. He certainly sees and knows all about His servants.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say: "Sufficient is Allah for a witness between me and you. Verily! He is the All-Knower, the All-Seer of His slaves."
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'God suffices as a witness between me and you; surely He is aware of and sees His servants.'

ayahs.transliteration: waman yahdi l-lahu fahuwa l-muh'tadi waman yuḍ'lil falan tajida lahum awliyāa min dūnihi wanaḥshuruhum yawma l-qiyāmati ʿalā wujūhihim ʿum'yan wabuk'man waṣumman mawāhum jahannamu kullamā khabat zid'nāhum saʿīran
ayahs.translation_bn: আল্লাহ যাকে সঠিক পথে পরিচালিত করেন সে পথপ্রাপ্ত আর যাদেরকে তিনি পথভ্রষ্ট করেন, তুমি কক্ষনো তাদের জন্য তাঁকে ছাড়া অন্য কাউকে অভিভাবক পাবে না। ক্বিয়ামাতের দিন আমি তাদেরকে একত্রিত করব তাদের মুখের ভরে অন্ধ, বোবা ও বধির অবস্থায়। তাদের আবাস হচ্ছে জাহান্নাম। যখনই তার আগুন নিস্তেজ হয়ে আসবে, আমি তাদের জন্য অগ্নির দহন শক্তি বৃদ্ধি করে দেব।
ayahs.translation_en: And whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides We increase them in blazing fire.
ayahs.conventional_en: And whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides We increase them in blazing fire.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আল্লাহ যাকে পথ প্রদর্শন করেন, সে-ই তো পথপ্রাপ্ত; আর যাদের তিনি পথভ্রষ্ট করেন, তুমি কখনই তাঁর পরিবর্তে তাদের জন্য কোনো অভিভাবক পাবে না; আর কিয়ামতের দিন আমি তাদেরকে তাদের মুখের ওপর ভর দেওয়া অবস্থায় অন্ধ, মূক ও বধির করে সমবেত করব; তাদের আবাসস্থল হবে জাহান্নাম; যখনই তা কিছুটা স্তিমিত হবে, আমি তাদের জন্য প্রজ্বলিত অগ্নিশিখা বাড়িয়ে দেব।

english_translations.sahih_international: And whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides We increase them in blazing fire.
english_translations.pickthall: And he whom Allah guideth, he is led aright; while, as for him whom He sendeth astray, for them thou wilt find no protecting friends beside Him, and We shall assemble them on the Day of Resurrection on their faces, blind, dumb and deaf; their habitation will be hell; whenever it abateth, We increase the flame for them.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: It is he whom Allah guides, that is on true Guidance; but he whom He leaves astray - for such wilt thou find no protector besides Him. On the Day of Judgment We shall gather, them together, prone on their faces, blind, dumb, and deaf: their abode will be Hell: every time it shows abatement, We shall increase from them the fierceness of the Fire.
english_translations.shakir: And whomsoever Allah guides, he is the follower of the right way, and whomsoever He causes to err, you shall not find for him guardians besides Him; and We will gather them together on the day of resurrection on their faces, blind and dumb and deaf; their abode is hell; whenever it becomes allayed We will add to their burning.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Whomever God has guided has the proper guidance. You will never find any guardian besides God for the one whom He has caused to go astray. On the Day of Judgment, We will gather them lying on their faces, blind, dumb and deaf. Hell will be their dwelling. As hell fire abates, We will increase its blazing force.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And he whom Allah guides, he is led aright; but he whom He sends astray for such you will find no Auliya' (helpers and protectors, etc.), besides Him, and We shall gather them together on the Day of Resurrection on their faces, blind, dumb and deaf, their abode will be Hell; whenever it abates, We shall increase for them the fierceness of the Fire.
english_translations.arberry: Whomsoever God guides, he is rightly guided; and whom He leads astray -- thou wilt not find for them protectors, apart from Him. And We shall muster them on the Resurrection Day upon their faces, blind, dumb, deaf; their refuge shall be Gehenna, and whensoever it abates We shall increase for them the Blaze.

ayahs.transliteration: dhālika jazāuhum bi-annahum kafarū biāyātinā waqālū a-idhā kunnā ʿiẓāman warufātan a-innā lamabʿūthūna khalqan jadīdan
ayahs.translation_bn: এটাই তাদের প্রতিফল, কেননা তারা আমার নিদর্শনসমূহ প্রত্যাখ্যান করেছিল আর বলেছিল, ‘যখন আমরা হাড্ডি ও চূর্ণ ধূলায় পরিণত হব তখনও কি আমাদেরকে নতুন এক সৃষ্টির আকারে আবার উঠানো হবে?’
ayahs.translation_en: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
ayahs.conventional_en: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
ayahs.conventional_bn: এটাই তাদের প্রতিফল, কারণ তারা আমার নিদর্শনসমূহ অস্বীকার করেছিল এবং বলেছিল, ‘আমরা যখন অস্থি ও চূর্ণ-বিচূর্ণ ধূলিকণায় পরিণত হব, তখনও কি আমরা নতুন সৃষ্টিরূপে পুনরুত্থিত হব’?
ayahs.meta_bn: বায়ো-ডিকমিশনিং সংশয় ও পুনরুত্থানের অস্বীকৃতি

english_translations.sahih_international: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
english_translations.pickthall: That is their reward because they disbelieved Our revelations and said: When we are bones and fragments shall we, forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: That is their recompense, because they rejected Our signs, and said, "When we are reduced to bones and broken dust, should we really be raised up (to be) a new Creation?"
english_translations.shakir: This is their retribution because they disbelieved in Our communications and said What! when we shall have become bones and decayed particles, shall we then indeed be raised up into a new creation?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: This will be the recompense for their disbelief of Our revelations and for their saying, "Shall we be brought to life again after becoming bones and dust?"
english_translations.mohsin_khan: That is their recompense, because they denied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and said: "When we are bones and fragments, shall we really be raised up as a new creation?"
english_translations.arberry: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our signs and said, 'What, when we are bones and broken bits, shall we really be raised up again in a new creation?'

ayahs.transliteration: awalam yaraw anna l-laha alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa qādirun ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum wajaʿala lahum ajalan lā rayba fīhi fa-abā l-ẓālimūna illā kufūran
ayahs.translation_bn: তারা কি লক্ষ্য করে না যে আল্লাহ- যিনি আসমানসমূহ ও যমীন সৃষ্টি করেছেন- তিনি তাদের মত মানুষ (পুনরায়) সৃষ্টি করতে সক্ষম। তিনি তাদের জন্য একটা সুনির্দিষ্ট সময় স্থির করেছেন, যাতে কোনই সন্দেহ নেই। কিন্তু যালিমরা অমান্য করে কেবল কুফরিই করল।
ayahs.translation_en: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse [anything] except disbelief.
ayahs.conventional_en: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse [anything] except disbelief.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারা কি লক্ষ্য করে না যে, আল্লাহ—যিনি আসমানসমূহ ও যমীন সৃষ্টি করেছেন—তিনি তাদের অনুরূপ সৃষ্টি করতে পুরোপুরি সক্ষম? এবং তিনি তাদের জন্য একটি নির্দিষ্ট সময় নির্ধারণ করেছেন যাতে কোনো সন্দেহ নেই; তবুও জালেমরা কুফরি ছাড়া সবকিছুতেই অস্বীকার করেছে।

english_translations.sahih_international: Do they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse [anything] except disbelief.
english_translations.pickthall: Have they not seen that Allah Who created the heavens and the earth is Able to create the like of them, and hath appointed for them an end whereof there is no doubt? But the wrong-doers refuse aught save disbelief.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: See they not that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, has power to create the like of them (anew)? Only He has decreed a term appointed, of which there is no doubt. But the unjust refuse (to receive it) except with ingratitude.
english_translations.shakir: Do they not consider that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, is able to create their like, and He has appointed for them a doom about which there is no doubt? But the unjust do not consent to aught but denying.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Do they not realize that God, who has created the heavens and the earth, has the power to create their like? He has given them life for an appointed time of which there is no doubt. The unjust turn away in disbelief (from Our revelation).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: See they not that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, is Able to create the like of them. And He has decreed for them an appointed term, whereof there is not doubt. But the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.) refuse (the truth the Message of Islamic Monotheism, and accept nothing) but disbelief.
english_translations.arberry: Have they not seen that God, who created the heavens and earth, is powerful to create the like of them? He has appointed for them a term, no doubt of it; yet the unbelievers refuse all but unbelief.

ayahs.transliteration: qul law antum tamlikūna khazāina raḥmati rabbī idhan la-amsaktum khashyata l-infāqi wakāna l-insānu qatūran
ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘তোমরা যদি আমার প্রতিপালকের রাহমাতের ভান্ডারের মালিক হয়ে যেতে, তবুও খরচ হয়ে যাবার ভয়ে তোমরা তা অবশ্যই ধরে রাখতে।’ বাস্তবিকই মানুষ বড়ই সংকীর্ণ-চিত্ত।
ayahs.translation_en: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
ayahs.conventional_en: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো, ‘যদি তোমরা আমার প্রতিপালকের রহমতের ভাণ্ডারের মালিক হতে, তবে তোমরা নিঃশেষ হয়ে যাওয়ার ভয়ে অবশ্যই তা ধরে রাখতে’; আর মানুষ তো অতিশয় কৃপণ!

english_translations.sahih_international: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
english_translations.pickthall: Say (unto them): If ye possessed the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, ye would surely hold them back for fear of spending, for man was ever grudging.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "If ye had control of the Treasures of the Mercy of my Lord, behold, ye would keep them back, for fear of spending them: for man is (every) niggardly!"
english_translations.shakir: Say: If you control the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold (them) from fear of spending, and man is niggardly.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "Had you owned the treasures of the Mercy of my Lord, you would have locked them up for fear of spending them. The human being has always been stingy.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say (to the disbelievers): "If you possessed the treasure of the Mercy of my Lord (wealth, money, provision, etc.), then you would surely hold back (from spending) for fear of (being exhausted), and man is ever miserly!"
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'If you possessed the treasuries of my Lord's mercy, yet would you hold back for fear of expending; and man is ever niggardly.'

ayahs.transliteration: walaqad ātaynā mūsā tis'ʿa āyātin bayyinātin fasal banī is'rāīla idh jāahum faqāla lahu fir'ʿawnu innī la-aẓunnuka yāmūsā masḥūran
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি মূসাকে নয়টি স্পষ্ট নিদর্শন দিয়েছিলাম। বানী ইসরাঈলকে জিজ্ঞেস করে দেখ, যখন সে তাদের (অর্থাৎ ফির‘আওন ও তার প্রধানদের) নিকট আসল তখন ফির‘আওন তাকে বলল, ‘ওহে মূসা! আমি তোমাকে অবশ্যই যাদুগ্রস্ত মনে করি।’
ayahs.translation_en: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
ayahs.conventional_en: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি অবশ্যই মূসাকে নয়টি স্পষ্ট নিদর্শন দিয়েছিলাম; সুতরাং বনি ইসরাঈলকে জিজ্ঞেস করো—যখন সে তাদের কাছে এসেছিল, তখন ফেরাউন তাকে বলেছিল, ‘হে মূসা! নিশ্চয়ই আমি তোমাকে জাদুগ্রস্ত মনে করি’।

english_translations.sahih_international: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
english_translations.pickthall: And verily We gave unto Moses nine tokens, clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty). Do but ask the Children of Israel how he came unto them, then Pharaoh said unto him: Lo! I deem thee one bewitched, O Moses.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: To Moses We did give Nine Clear Signs: As the Children of Israel: when he came to them, Pharaoh said to him: "O Moses! I consider thee, indeed, to have been worked upon by sorcery!
english_translations.shakir: And certainly We gave Musa nine clear signs; so ask the children of Israel. When he came to them, Firon said to him: Most surely I deem you, O Musa, to be a man deprived of reason.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: To Moses We gave nine illustrious miracles. Ask the Israelites; Moses came to them. The Pharaoh said to him,"Moses, I believe that you are bewitched".
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And indeed We gave to Musa (Moses) nine clear signs. Ask then the Children of Israel, when he came to them, then Fir'aun (Pharaoh) said to him: "O Musa (Moses)! I think you are indeed bewitched."
english_translations.arberry: And We gave Moses nine signs, clear signs. Ask the Children of Israel when he came to them, and Pharaoh said to him, 'Moses, I think thou art bewitched.'

ayahs.transliteration: qāla laqad ʿalim'ta mā anzala hāulāi illā rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi baṣāira wa-innī la-aẓunnuka yāfir'ʿawnu mathbūran
ayahs.translation_bn: মূসা বলল, ‘তুমি তো জান যে, এসব চোখ-খুলে-দেয়া নিদর্শন আসমানসমূহ ও যমীনের প্রতিপালক ছাড়া অন্য কেউ অবতীর্ণ করেনি, হে ফির‘আওন! আমি তো তোমাকে মনে করি এক ধ্বংসপ্রাপ্ত লোক।’
ayahs.translation_en: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
ayahs.conventional_en: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
ayahs.conventional_bn: মূসা বলল, ‘তুমি অবশ্যই জানো যে, এই চোখ-খুলে-দেওয়া নিদর্শনসমূহ আসমান ও যমীনের প্রতিপালক ছাড়া অন্য কেউ নাযিল করেননি; আর হে ফেরাউন! নিশ্চয়ই আমি তোমাকে ধ্বংসপ্রাপ্ত মনে করি’!
ayahs.meta_bn: এনলাইটেনমেন্ট সিগনেচার্স ও টার্মিনাল ডিকমিশনিং প্রেডিকশন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: بَصَائِرَ — চক্ষুষ্মানকারী প্রমাণ / ডেটা-ভিজুয়াল সিগনেচার্স; مَثْبُورًا — ধ্বংসপ্রাপ্ত / ডেটা-ডিকমিশনড স্টেট।
