metadata.theme_bn: আসমান-জমিনের প্রতিপালকের সার্বভৌমত্ব স্বীকার ও ফেরাউনের অনিবার্য ধ্বংসের পূর্বাভাস

english_translations.sahih_international: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
english_translations.pickthall: He said: In truth thou knowest that none sent down these (portents) save the Lord of the heavens and the earth as proofs, and lo! (for my part) I deem thee lost, O Pharaoh.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Moses said, "Thou knowest well that these things have been sent down by none but the Lord of the heavens and the earth as eye-opening evidence: and I consider thee indeed, O Pharaoh, to be one doomed to destruction!"
english_translations.shakir: He said: Truly you know that none but the Lord of the heavens and the earth has sent down these as clear proof and most surely I believe you, O Firon, to be given over to perdition.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: He replied, "Certainly you have come to know that these have been sent by the Lord of the heavens and the earth as lessons to people. Pharaoh, I believe that you are doomed to perdition.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: [Musa (Moses)] said: "Verily, you know that these signs have been sent down by none but the Lord of the heavens and the earth as clear (evidences i.e. proofs of Allah's Oneness and His Omnipotence, etc.). And I think you are, indeed, O Fir'aun (Pharaoh) doomed to destruction (away from all good)!"
english_translations.arberry: He said, 'Indeed thou knowest that none sent these down, except the Lord of the heavens and earth, as clear proofs; and, Pharaoh, I think thou art accursed.'

ayahs.transliteration: fa-arāda an yastafizzahum mina l-arḍi fa-aghraqnāhu waman maʿahu jamīʿan
ayahs.translation_bn: অতঃপর ফিরআউন তাদেরকে দুনিয়া থেকে সরিয়ে দিতে চাইল। তখন আমি তাকে আর তার সঙ্গী-সাথীদের সব্বাইকে ডুবিয়ে মারলাম।
ayahs.translation_en: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
ayahs.conventional_en: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অতঃপর সে তাদেরকে সে দেশ থেকে উৎখাত করতে চাইল; তখন আমি তাকে এবং তার সাথে যারা ছিল তাদের সবাইকে পানিতে নিমজ্জিত করে ধ্বংস করলাম।
ayahs.meta_bn: অ্যাটেম্পটেড ডিসপ্লেসমেন্ট ও টোটাল ওভারফ্লো শাটডাউন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: يَسْتَفِزَّهُم — ডেটা-ডিসপ্লেস / বাস্তুচ্যুত করার অপচেষ্টা; فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُ — নিমজ্জিত বা ওভারফ্লো শাটডাউন করা।

metadata.theme: অ্যাটেম্পটেড ডিসপ্লেসমেন্ট ও টোটাল ওভারফ্লো শাটডাউন
metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: يَسْتَفِزَّهُم — ডেটা-ডিসপ্লেস / বাস্তুচ্যুত করার অপচেষ্টা; فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُ — নিমজ্জিত বা ওভারফ্লো শাটডাউন করা।
metadata.theme_bn: জমিন থেকে উচ্ছেদের অপচেষ্টা এবং সমুদ্রে ফেরাউনবাহিনীর সামগ্রিক নিমজ্জন

english_translations.sahih_international: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
english_translations.pickthall: And he wished to scare them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him, all together.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: So he resolved to remove them from the face of the earth: but We did drown him and all who were with him.
english_translations.shakir: So he desired to destroy them out of the earth, but We drowned him and those with him all together;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh wanted to expel the Israelites from the land so We drowned him and all who were with him.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: So he resolved to turn them out of the land (of Egypt). But We drowned him and all who were with him.
english_translations.arberry: He desired to startle them from the land; and We drowned him and those with him, all together.

ayahs.transliteration: waqul'nā min baʿdihi libanī is'rāīla us'kunū l-arḍa fa-idhā jāa waʿdu l-ākhirati ji'nā bikum lafīfan
ayahs.translation_bn: এরপর আমি বানী ইসরাঈলকে বললাম, ‘তোমরা যমীনের উপর বসবাস কর, অতঃপর যখন প্রতিশ্রুত ক্বিয়ামাত আসবে তখন আমি তোমাদেরকে সংমিশ্রিত দলবলে হাজির করব।’
ayahs.translation_en: And We said after Pharaoh to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
ayahs.conventional_en: And We said after Pharaoh to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর তার পর আমি বনি ইসরাঈলকে বললাম, ‘তোমরা এ যমীনে বসবাস করো; অতঃপর যখন আখিরাতের ওয়াদা আসবে, তখন আমি তোমাদের সবাইকে এক সংমিশ্রিত দলবদ্ধরূপে উপস্থিত করব’।
ayahs.meta_bn: টেরিস্ট্রিয়াল রেসিডেন্স ও এন্ড-টাইমস মিক্সড গ্যাদারিং
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: اسْكُنُوا الْأَرْضَ — ভূমিতে বসবাস বা ডেটা-রেসিডেন্স স্থাপন; وَعْدُ الْآخِرَةِ — পরকালের প্রতিশ্রুতি / ডেটা-রি-ইন্টিগ্রেশন প্রমিস; لَفِيفًا — একত্র ও মিশ্রিত অবস্থায় / ডেটা-মিক্সড স্টেট।

metadata.theme_bn: স্বৈরাচারোত্তর ভূখণ্ডে পুনর্বাসন ও কিয়ামতে সমন্বিত সমবেতকরণ

english_translations.sahih_international: And We said after Pharaoh to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
english_translations.pickthall: And We said unto the Children of Israel after him: Dwell in the land; but when the promise of the Hereafter cometh to pass We shall bring you as a crowd gathered out of various nations.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And We said thereafter to the Children of Israel, "Dwell securely in the land (of promise)": but when the second of the warnings came to pass, We gathered you together in a mingled crowd.
english_translations.shakir: And We said to the Israelites after him: Dwell in the land: and when the promise of the next life shall come to pass, we will bring you both together in judgment.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We told the Israelites after this to settle in the land until Our second promise will come true. We would then gather them all together (on the Day of Judgment).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And We said to the Children of Israel after him: "Dwell in the land, then, when the final and the last promise comes near [i.e. the Day of Resurrection or the descent of Christ ['Iesa (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary) on the earth]. We shall bring you altogether as mixed crowd (gathered out of various nations). [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi, Vol. 10, Page 338]
english_translations.arberry: And We said to the Children of Israel after him, 'Dwell in the land; and when the promise of the world to come comes to pass, We shall bring you a rabble.'

ayahs.transliteration: wabil-ḥaqi anzalnāhu wabil-ḥaqi nazala wamā arsalnāka illā mubashiran wanadhīran
ayahs.translation_bn: এ কুরআনকে আমি সত্যতা সহকারে নাযিল করেছি আর সত্যতা সহকারেই তা নাযিল হয়েছে। আমি তোমাকে শুধু সুসংবাদদাতা ও সতর্ককারী হিসেবে পাঠিয়েছি।

words.translation_en: as a bearer of glad tidings

ayahs.translation_en: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.conventional_en: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি এই কুরআনকে সত্যসহকারে নাযিল করেছি এবং তা সত্যসহকারেই নাযিল হয়েছে; আর আমি তোমাকে কেবল সুসংবাদদাতা ও সতর্ককারীরূপেই প্রেরণ করেছি।
ayahs.meta_bn: ট্রুথ-বেসড ডাউনলিংক ও বাইপোলার সিগন্যাল ট্রান্সমিশন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: بِالْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَاهُ — পরম সত্য ও অপরিবর্তনীয় প্রটোকল সহকারে অবতরণ; مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا — শুভসংবাদদাতা ও সতর্ককারী / পজিটিভ ও নেগেটিভ সিগন্যাল ট্রান্সমিটার।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: بِالْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَاهُ — পরম সত্য ও অপরিবর্তনীয় প্রটোকল সহকারে অবতরণ; مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا — শুভসংবাদদাতা ও সতর্ককারী / পজিটিভ ও নেগেটিভ সিগন্যাল ট্রান্সমিটার।
metadata.theme_bn: বিশুদ্ধ সত্যের ঐশী অবতরণ এবং সুসংবাদদাতা ও সতর্ককারীর দ্বৈত দায়িত্ব

english_translations.sahih_international: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
english_translations.pickthall: With truth have We sent it down, and with truth hath it descended. And We have sent thee as naught else save a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: We sent down the (Qur'an) in Truth, and in Truth has it descended: and We sent thee but to give Glad Tidings and to warn (sinners).
english_translations.shakir: And with truth have We revealed it, and with truth did it come; and We have not sent you but as the giver of good news and as a warner.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We sent it (the Quran) in all Truth and in all Truth it came. (Muhammad), We have sent you for no other reason than to be a bearer of glad news and a warner.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And with truth We have sent it down (i.e. the Quran), and with truth it has descended. And We have sent you (O Muhammad SAW) as nothing but a bearer of glad tidings (of Paradise, for those who follow your Message of Islamic Monotheism), and a warner (of Hell-fire for those who refuse to follow your Message of Islamic Monotheism).
english_translations.arberry: With the truth We have sent it down, and with the truth it has come down; and We have sent thee not, except good tidings to bear, and warning;

ayahs.transliteration: waqur'ānan faraqnāhu litaqra-ahu ʿalā l-nāsi ʿalā muk'thin wanazzalnāhu tanzīlan
ayahs.translation_bn: আমি এ কুরআনকে ভাগে ভাগে বিভক্ত করেছি যাতে তুমি থেমে থেমে মানুষকে তা পাঠ করে শুনাতে পার, কাজেই আমি তা ক্রমশঃ নাযিল করেছি।
ayahs.translation_en: And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
ayahs.conventional_en: And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি কুরআনকে খণ্ড খণ্ড করে নাযিল করেছি—যাতে তুমি বিরতি দিয়ে মানুষের কাছে তা পাঠ করতে পারো, এবং আমি তা পর্যায়ক্রমে নাযিল করেছি।
ayahs.meta_bn: স্টেজড সেগমেন্টেশন ও গ্র্যাজুয়াল রিলিজ প্রটোকল
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: فَرَقْنَاهُ — ভাগে ভাগে বা অধ্যায়ভিত্তিক বিন্যাস; عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ — বিরতি দিয়ে ধীরে ধীরে / ধাপে ধাপে; تَنزِيلًا — সুপরিকল্পিত ক্রমান্বয়িক অবতরণ।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: فَرَقْنَاهُ — ভাগে ভাগে বা অধ্যায়ভিত্তিক বিন্যাস; عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ — বিরতি দিয়ে ধীরে ধীরে / ধাপে ধাপে; تَنزِيلًا — সুপরিকল্পিত ক্রমান্বয়িক অবতরণ।
metadata.theme_bn: পর্যাবৃত্ত ও ধাপে ধাপে কুরআন অবতরণ: মানবচেতনায় পর্যায়ক্রমিক অনুধাবন

english_translations.sahih_international: And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
english_translations.pickthall: And (it is) a Qur'an that We have divided, that thou mayst recite it unto mankind at intervals, and We have revealed it by (successive) revelation.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: (It is) a Qur'an which We have divided (into parts from time to time), in order that thou mightest recite it to men at intervals: We have revealed it by stages.
english_translations.shakir: And it is a Quran which We have revealed in portions so that you may read it to the people by slow degrees, and We have revealed it, revealing in portions.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: We have divided the Quran into many segments so that you would read them to the people in gradual steps as We reveal them to you from time to time.

ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘তোমরা আল্লাহ নামে ডাকো বা রহমান নামে ডাকো, যে নামেই তাঁকে ডাকো না কেন (সবই ভাল) কেননা সকল সুন্দর নামই তো তাঁর।’ তোমার সলাতে স্বর উচ্চ করো না, আর তা খুব নীচুও করো না, এ দু’য়ের মধ্যবর্তী পথ অবলম্বন কর।
ayahs.translation_en: Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
ayahs.conventional_en: Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
ayahs.conventional_bn: বলো—‘তোমরা আল্লাহ বলে ডাকো অথবা রহমান বলে ডাকো; যাই ডাকো না কেন, তাঁর জন্য উত্তম নামসমূহ রয়েছে; তোমার সালাত খুব জোরে পড়ো না এবং খুব আস্তে পড়ো না; বরং মধ্যম পন্থা অবলম্বন করো’।

english_translations.sahih_international: Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
english_translations.pickthall: Say (unto mankind): Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent, unto whichsoever ye cry (it is the same). His are the most beautiful names. And thou (Muhammad), be not loud-voiced in thy worship nor yet silent therein, but follow a way between.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "Call upon Allah, or call upon Rahman: by whatever name ye call upon Him, (it is well): for to Him belong the Most Beautiful Names. Neither speak thy Prayer aloud, nor speak it in a low tone, but seek a middle course between."
english_translations.shakir: Say: Call upon Allah or call upon, the Beneficent Allah; whichever you call upon, He has the best names; and do not utter your prayer with a very raised voice nor be silent with regard to it, and seek a way between these.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them, "It is all the same whether you call Him God or the Beneficent. All the good names belong to Him." (Muhammad), do not be too loud or slow in your prayer. Choose a moderate way of praying.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "Invoke Allah or invoke the Most Beneficent (Allah), by whatever name you invoke Him (it is the same), for to Him belong the Best Names. And offer your Salat (prayer) neither aloud nor in a low voice, but follow a way between.
english_translations.arberry: Say: 'Call upon God, or call upon the Merciful; whichsoever you call upon, to Him belong the Names Most Beautiful.' And be thou not loud in thy prayer, nor hushed therein, but seek thou for a way between that.

ayahs.translation_bn: বল, ‘সকল প্রশংসাই আল্লাহর যিনি সন্তান গ্রহণ করেন না, যাঁর শাসন-কর্তৃত্বে কোন অংশীদার নেই, দুর্দশাগ্রস্ত হওয়া থেকে বাঁচার জন্য যাঁর কোন অভিভাবকের প্রয়োজন হয় না। অতএব পূর্ণ শ্রেষ্ঠত্বে তাঁর শ্রেষ্ঠত্ব ঘোষণা কর।
ayahs.translation_en: And say, "Praise to Allah, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
ayahs.conventional_en: And say, "Praise to Allah, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ — সমস্ত প্রশংসা ও ডেটা-থ্যাংকস সিগন্যাল; لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا — সন্তান বা বংশীয় স্তরবিন্যাস গ্রহণ করেননি; شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ — সার্বভৌম কর্তৃত্বে কোনো অংশীদার নেই; وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ — দুর্বলতাজনিত সহায়তাকারী নোড নেই; كَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا — পূর্ণ মর্যাদায় শ্রেষ্ঠত্ব ঘোষণা।
metadata.meta_en: Absolute Monotheistic Sovereignty, Zero Lineage & Infinite Greatness

english_translations.sahih_international: And say, "Praise to Allah, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
english_translations.pickthall: And say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath not taken unto Himself a son, and Who hath no partner in the Sovereignty, nor hath He any protecting friend through dependence. And magnify Him with all magnificence.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Say: "Praise be to Allah, who begets no son, and has no partner in (His) dominion: Nor (needs) He any to protect Him from humiliation: yea, magnify Him for His greatness and glory!"
english_translations.shakir: And say: (All) praise is due to Allah, Who has not taken a son and Who has not a partner in the kingdom, and Who has not a helper to save Him from disgrace; and proclaim His greatness magnifying (Him).
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "It is only God who deserves all praise. He has not begotten a son and has no partner in His Kingdom. He does not need any guardian to help Him in His need. Proclaim His greatness.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allah, Who has not begotten a son (nor an offspring), and Who has no partner in (His) Dominion, nor He is low to have a Wali (helper, protector or supporter). And magnify Him with all the magnificence, [Allahu-Akbar (Allah is the Most Great)]."
english_translations.arberry: And say: 'Praise belongs to God, who has not taken to Him a son, and who has not any associate in the Kingdom, nor any protector out of humbleness.' And magnify Him with repeated magnificats.
